zh-tw.title: 學生厭世語錄
zh-tw.description: 從早八、小組報告到期末週崩潰，每個還在學校裡掙扎的學生都懂的共感金句，在校生專屬的廢話文學

en.title: Student Life Quotes
en.description: From 8 a.m. lectures to group projects and finals-week meltdowns — relatable lines every student stuck on campus will feel in their soul

items.sourceNote: Dcard 升大學板 早八共感格式改寫

zh-tw.content:
選課的時候我以為自己會早起，
早八第三週，我已經改用老師的課堂直播當鬧鐘了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學選到早八後發限動的標準自嘲，同病相憐的同學會秒回。
variations: 進階版：「早八不是一堂課，是一種修行。」
也能換成：「我跟早八的關係，就是它每週準時，我每週遲到。」

en.content:
When I picked my classes I genuinely believed I'd become a morning person.
Week three of the 8 a.m. lecture, I'm using the recorded livestream as my alarm clock.
en.editorNote: The go-to caption for anyone who scheduled an early class and instantly regretted it.
variations: Harder mode: "An 8 a.m. class isn't a course, it's a spiritual trial."
Swap in: "Me and my morning lecture: it shows up on time, I don't."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 大學生 小組作業常見抱怨改寫

zh-tw.content:
小組報告的真相：
一個人做事，三個人掛名，還有一個人在問什麼時候要交。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被當組長獨自爆肝後，丟到班級群組會引發大量共鳴。
variations: 也能換成：「分工表上五個人，凌晨三點的會議室只有我自己。」
進階版：「組員已讀不回的速度，比我做報告的速度還快。」

en.content:
The truth about group projects:
one person does the work, three put their names on it, and one keeps asking when it's due.
en.editorNote: Post-meltdown caption for the group leader who pulled the whole thing alone.
variations: Swap in: "Five names on the cover page, one person in the 3 a.m. study room."
Harder mode: "My teammates leave my messages on read faster than I finish the slides."

items.sourceNote: 大學生熬夜趕報告共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
報告的繳交期限是凌晨十二點，
我的靈感則是在十一點五十八分準時報到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 趕 deadline 趕到天亮的人都懂，適合搭配一張凌亂書桌的照片。
variations: 也能換成：「不是我愛拖，是壓力到了才肯給我靈感。」
進階版：「靈感跟公車一樣，要等到最後一刻才會一起來。」

en.content:
The assignment is due at midnight,
and my inspiration clocks in promptly at 11:58 p.m.
en.editorNote: For everyone who's pulled an all-nighter against a deadline — pair it with a photo of a chaotic desk.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not lazy, my brain just refuses to work until the pressure hits."
Harder mode: "Inspiration is like the bus — it only shows up at the last possible second."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 翹課話題 改寫

zh-tw.content:
今天我沒翹課，
不是因為我突然變認真，是因為今天剛好要點名。
zh-tw.editorNote: 出席率全靠點名表現的同學的真心話，丟群組大家會心一笑。
variations: 也能換成：「我跟這堂課的緣分，全看老師今天點不點名。」
進階版：「老師說『今天不點名』那一刻，整間教室瞬間少一半人。」

en.content:
I didn't skip class today —
not because I suddenly got serious, but because today happens to be attendance day.
en.editorNote: The honest confession of anyone whose attendance rate is held up entirely by roll call.
variations: Swap in: "My bond with this class depends entirely on whether the professor takes attendance."
Harder mode: "The second the prof says 'no roll call today,' half the room vanishes."

items.sourceNote: 期末週崩潰 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
期末週的我，
成功把「等等再讀」這四個字，活成了一種人生哲學。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末週發限動配書還沒翻開的照片，朋友一看就懂。
variations: 也能換成：「進度條卡在百分之零，但我的焦慮已經滿格。」
進階版：「考試範圍我背得很熟，背的是『範圍』兩個字。」

en.content:
During finals week,
I've successfully turned "I'll study later" into an entire philosophy of life.
en.editorNote: Post this during finals next to a photo of an unopened textbook — friends will get it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "Progress bar stuck at zero, anxiety bar completely full."
Harder mode: "I know the exam scope by heart — just the word 'scope,' though."

items.sourceNote: 不及格自嘲 廢文金句改寫

zh-tw.content:
六十分萬歲，五十九分對不起父母，
但說實話，這次我連對不起的資格都沒準備好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績單發下來後的自我安慰，越廢越有共鳴。
variations: 也能換成：「低空飛過也是飛過，重點是飛過。」
進階版：「分數不重要，重要的是我跟它一樣，沒什麼內容。」

en.content:
Sixty is a victory, fifty-nine is an apology to my parents —
but honestly, this time I didn't even prepare enough to deserve the apology.
en.editorNote: Self-soothing caption for the day grades drop — the more deadpan, the more relatable.
variations: Swap in: "Barely passing is still passing. Focus on the 'passing' part."
Harder mode: "The grade doesn't matter — what matters is that it and I both have no substance."

items.sourceNote: 通識課選課標準 改寫

zh-tw.content:
我選通識課的標準只有三個：
不點名、能涼、最好還能加分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 選課週的真心話，丟到系上群組會被瘋狂認同。
variations: 也能換成：「營養學分不是學分，是大學生活的維生素。」
進階版：「課表排得鬆不鬆，決定我這學期快不快樂。」

en.content:
I have exactly three criteria for picking an elective:
no roll call, easy grading, and ideally a curve.
en.editorNote: The course-registration confession — drop it in the department group chat for instant agreement.
variations: Swap in: "An easy-A class isn't credit, it's a vitamin for college life."
Harder mode: "How loose my schedule is decides how happy I'll be this semester."

items.sourceNote: 學貸打工 對比厭世改寫

zh-tw.content:
別人的大學是社團、戀愛、出國交換；
我的大學是排班、報告、還有學貸的利息。
zh-tw.editorNote: 半工半讀的同學的真實寫照，配一張打工制服的照片更有畫面。
variations: 也能換成：「我也想說走就走，但我先走去打工。」
進階版：「青春無價，但我的青春正在按時薪計算。」

en.content:
Other people's college years are clubs, dating, and studying abroad;
mine are work shifts, assignments, and the interest on my student loan.
en.editorNote: A real portrait of the working student — even better next to a photo in a part-time uniform.
variations: Swap in: "I'd love a spontaneous trip too — right after my shift."
Harder mode: "Youth is priceless, but mine is currently billed by the hour."

items.sourceNote: 重考生厭世 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
重考這一年我最大的成長，
是學會對親戚那句「考得怎麼樣」微笑帶過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 重考生過年最有感，適合年節或放榜前後發文。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是失敗，我只是給夢想多買了一年的時間。」
進階版：「同學都升大二了，我還在跟去年的自己同班。」

en.content:
My biggest growth during this gap year of retaking exams
is learning to just smile and dodge when relatives ask, "So how'd it go?"
en.editorNote: Hits hardest for retake students during family gatherings or around results day.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not a failure, I just bought my dream one more year of time."
Harder mode: "My classmates are sophomores now and I'm still in the same class as last year's me."

items.sourceNote: 廢話文學 段考版改寫

zh-tw.content:
考試永遠不會背叛你，
因為你根本沒準備，它連背叛你的機會都不給。
zh-tw.editorNote: 標準廢話文學句型，考前發文用，朋友會說「講得好像很有道理」。
variations: 也能換成：「沒讀的人不會緊張，因為連緊張的本錢都沒有。」
進階版：「不會的題目不用慌，反正會的也沒幾題。」

en.content:
An exam will never betray you,
because you never prepared — it doesn't even get the chance to.
en.editorNote: Classic nonsense-literature format for pre-exam posts. Friends will reply, "weirdly profound."
variations: Swap in: "People who didn't study never panic — they can't afford the panic either."
Harder mode: "Don't stress over the questions you can't do; you couldn't do many of the others either."

items.sourceNote: 圖書館佔位共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
期末週圖書館的位子，
比演唱會的票還難搶；搶到了，也不保證我真的讀得下去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末週去圖書館排隊佔位後發文，校內同學秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「佔到位子的成就感，已經消耗掉我一半的讀書動力。」
進階版：「我來圖書館不是為了讀書，是為了讓自己看起來有在讀書。」

en.content:
During finals week, a seat in the library
is harder to grab than concert tickets — and grabbing one still doesn't mean I'll actually study.
en.editorNote: Post it after lining up for a library seat during finals; every student on campus gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The thrill of finally getting a seat used up half my motivation to study."
Harder mode: "I don't come to the library to study, I come to look like I'm studying."

items.sourceNote: 咖啡因依賴 自嘲改寫

zh-tw.content:
我的血型是美式咖啡型，
一到期末週就自動升級成濃縮雙份。
zh-tw.editorNote: 離不開咖啡的考生最有感，搭配手搖或便利商店咖啡的照片。
variations: 也能換成：「睡眠是給沒有期末考的人的奢侈品。」
進階版：「咖啡因不是提神，是維持我這個人正常運作的最低需求。」

en.content:
My blood type is Americano,
and it automatically upgrades to a double shot of espresso once finals week hits.
en.editorNote: For students who can't function without coffee — pair with a convenience-store cup.
variations: Swap in: "Sleep is a luxury reserved for people who don't have finals."
Harder mode: "Caffeine isn't a boost, it's the minimum requirement for me to function as a person."

items.sourceNote: 教授名言反差 改寫

zh-tw.content:
教授說：「這個很簡單，大家應該都會。」
翻譯：接下來三十頁，我一個字都看不懂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 聽課聽到放棄的瞬間發文，全班都會默默點頭。
variations: 也能換成：「『這不考』是這堂課我唯一聽懂的一句話。」
進階版：「老師說『剩下回家自己看』，那本書到現在還是新的。」

en.content:
Professor: "This part is easy, everyone should get it."
Translation: for the next thirty pages, I won't understand a single word.
en.editorNote: Post it the moment you give up mid-lecture — the whole class will quietly nod.
variations: Swap in: "'This won't be on the test' is the only sentence I understood all class."
Harder mode: "The prof said 'read the rest at home' — that book is still brand new."

items.sourceNote: 開學收假厭世 改寫

zh-tw.content:
收假前一天的我，和開學第一天的我，
根本是兩個互不相識的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 連假或暑假尾聲的標準厭世文，收假症候群發作時最好用。
variations: 也能換成：「暑假作業的進度條，永遠停在開學前一晚。」
進階版：「放假的時候度日如年，開學之後一週像一天。」

en.content:
The me on the last day of break and the me on the first day of school
are honestly two complete strangers.
en.editorNote: The default end-of-break caption — perfect when post-vacation dread kicks in.
variations: Swap in: "My summer homework progress bar is permanently frozen at the night before school starts."
Harder mode: "On break, a day feels like a year; after school starts, a week feels like a day."

items.sourceNote: 拖延廢文 'I'll start tomorrow' 改寫

zh-tw.content:
我不是不讀書，我只是把開始的時間，
安排在一個永遠到不了的「明天」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 計畫表寫滿、書一頁沒翻的拖延體質專用，貼到群組大家都認領。
variations: 也能換成：「我的讀書計畫很完美，只差『執行』那一步。」
進階版：「明天的我超強，可惜我永遠活在今天。」

en.content:
It's not that I don't study —
I just scheduled my start time for a "tomorrow" that never actually arrives.
en.editorNote: For the chronic procrastinator with a full planner and an untouched textbook. Everyone in the chat will claim it.
variations: Swap in: "My study plan is flawless, it's just missing the 'do it' step."
Harder mode: "Tomorrow-me is unstoppable, shame I'm always stuck living in today."

items.sourceNote: 'brain has too many tabs open' 腦袋分頁梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
期末週我的腦袋開了太多分頁，
現在連哪一頁在播焦慮的背景音樂都找不到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 資訊量爆炸、整個人當機時最有感，配一張同時開十個視窗的螢幕截圖。
variations: 也能換成：「不是我不專心，是我的大腦正在無限轉圈圈讀取中。」
進階版：「要記的東西太多，記憶體不足，已自動關閉『睡眠』程式。」

en.content:
During finals week my brain has too many tabs open,
and now I can't even find which one is playing the anxiety background music.
en.editorNote: Hits hardest when you're info-overloaded and fully buffering. Pair with a screenshot of ten windows open at once.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not distracted, my brain is just stuck on the infinite loading spinner."
Harder mode: "Too much to memorize, out of RAM — the system auto-closed the 'sleep' program."

items.sourceNote: 睡過頭考試 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
鬧鐘響了十次我都按掉，
第十一次響的時候，是同學打來問我為什麼沒去考試。
zh-tw.editorNote: 睡過頭錯過考試或早八的災難現場，發出來朋友會又笑又同情。
variations: 也能換成：「我的鬧鐘很盡責，是我這個人不盡責。」
進階版：「我不是睡過頭，我只是把考試當成了可選配的行程。」

en.content:
I snoozed my alarm ten times,
and the eleventh ring was a classmate calling to ask why I wasn't at the exam.
en.editorNote: The disaster scene of oversleeping through an exam or 8 a.m. class — friends will laugh and pity you at once.
variations: Swap in: "My alarm is very dedicated, I'm the one who isn't."
Harder mode: "I didn't oversleep, I just treated the exam as an optional add-on."

items.sourceNote: GPA 自嘲 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
我的 GPA 跟我的存款一樣，
每次查的時候都希望它能多一點，結果每次都讓我安靜地關掉頁面。
zh-tw.editorNote: 查成績後默默闔上電腦的真實寫照，半夜發限動最有共鳴。
variations: 也能換成：「分數沒到，但我的接受度練得很好。」
進階版：「我不是學霸也不是學渣，我是介於兩者之間的學中。」

en.content:
My GPA is like my bank balance:
every time I check it I hope there's a bit more, and every time I just quietly close the tab.
en.editorNote: A true portrait of closing your laptop after checking grades — best posted as a late-night story.
variations: Swap in: "The grade didn't show up, but my acceptance of it is very well trained."
Harder mode: "I'm not a top student or a flunk-out, I'm somewhere in the muddled middle."

items.sourceNote: 宿舍生活 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
宿舍教會我最重要的一件事：
洗衣機永遠在我有空的時候滿的，在我趕時間的時候壞的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 住宿生的日常崩潰，搶不到洗衣機、室友作息對撞時發最有畫面。
variations: 也能換成：「我跟室友的作息，就像日班跟夜班，永遠在交接，永遠沒見過面。」
進階版：「宿舍的網路速度，決定我今天是個人還是一隻緩衝中的圈圈。」

en.content:
The most important thing dorm life taught me:
the washing machine is always full when I'm free, and always broken when I'm in a rush.
en.editorNote: Everyday dorm meltdown — most vivid when you can't grab a washer or your roommate's schedule clashes with yours.
variations: Swap in: "My roommate and I are like a day shift and a night shift — always handing off, never actually meeting."
Harder mode: "The dorm WiFi speed decides whether I'm a person today or just a buffering spinner."

items.sourceNote: 'finals week is a week-long panic attack with commercial breaks' 期末焦慮梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
期末週不是一個禮拜，
是一場為期七天、中間只有吃飯時間能喘口氣的恐慌發作。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末週整個人緊繃到極點時發文，全班都會回「+1」。
variations: 也能換成：「期末週的我只有兩種狀態：在崩潰，和準備崩潰。」
進階版：「別問我期末過得好不好，問我還活著就偷笑了。」

en.content:
Finals week isn't a week,
it's a seven-day panic attack with short breaks only for meals.
en.editorNote: Post it when you're wound up to the absolute limit during finals — the whole class will reply '+1'.
variations: Swap in: "During finals I have two modes: melting down, and about to melt down."
Harder mode: "Don't ask if my finals are going well — just be glad I'm still alive."

items.sourceNote: 'reading the same page for 20 minutes' 同一頁讀半天梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我已經盯著同一頁看了二十分鐘，
眼睛確實在動，但內容一個字都沒進到腦袋裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 讀書讀到放空、靈魂出竅的瞬間發文，朋友會說「這是我」。
variations: 也能換成：「我有在讀書，只是讀的是『發呆』這個科目。」
進階版：「書本翻到下一頁，是我整個下午唯一的進度。」

en.content:
I've been staring at the same page for twenty minutes —
my eyes are definitely moving, but not a single word has reached my brain.
en.editorNote: Post it the moment your soul leaves your body mid-study; friends will reply 'literally me'.
variations: Swap in: "I am studying — I'm just majoring in 'spacing out'."
Harder mode: "Turning to the next page was my only progress all afternoon."

items.sourceNote: 'I survived another semester, my plants didn't' 撐過一學期梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我成功撐過了這個學期，
代價是我的作息、我的存款，還有桌上那盆早就枯掉的多肉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 學期末勉強存活下來的總結文，適合期末考完或成績出爐後發。
variations: 也能換成：「這學期我沒被當，但我的生活品質被當得很徹底。」
進階版：「能順利結束一學期，已經是我這半年最大的成就。」

en.content:
I survived another semester —
the cost was my sleep schedule, my savings, and the succulent on my desk that died weeks ago.
en.editorNote: A wrap-up caption for barely making it to the end of term; great right after finals or grade releases.
variations: Swap in: "I didn't fail this semester, but my quality of life failed spectacularly."
Harder mode: "Finishing one semester in one piece is the biggest achievement of my half-year."

items.sourceNote: Dcard '大學報告真的是照妖鏡' 小組現形記改寫

zh-tw.content:
大學報告是一面照妖鏡，
你以為的隊友，分組之後才現出原形。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被雷組員氣到後的精準吐槽，丟班群一定有人對號入座。
variations: 也能換成：「不分組永遠不知道，原來身邊藏了這麼多人才——人在報告才出現的那種。」
進階版：「報告繳出去那一刻，我跟組員的緣分也正式結束。」

en.content:
A college group project is a mirror that reveals everyone's true form;
the teammates you thought you knew only show their real selves after the groups are set.
en.editorNote: A precise vent after a nightmare teammate — drop it in the class chat and someone will recognize themselves.
variations: Swap in: "You never know how much 'talent' is around you until a group project — the kind that only shows up on submission day."
Harder mode: "The second we submit the report, my bond with my teammates officially ends."

items.sourceNote: 'energy saving mode' 省電模式梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我不是懶，我只是長期處於省電模式，
而且不知道為什麼，充電孔好像壞了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 提不起勁讀書、整個人關機時發文，懶人同好會集體共鳴。
variations: 也能換成：「我的電量永遠停在百分之一，但就是不肯關機。」
進階版：「別人是越戰越勇，我是越讀越想睡。」

en.content:
I'm not lazy, I'm just permanently in energy-saving mode —
and for some reason the charging port seems broken too.
en.editorNote: Post it when you can't muster the will to study and you're fully powered down; fellow slackers will rally.
variations: Swap in: "My battery is stuck at one percent and still refuses to shut off."
Harder mode: "Other people get fired up the more they grind; I just get sleepier the more I read."

items.sourceNote: 'Day 1: organized. Day 2: who am I kidding' 開學決心崩壞梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
開學第一天：這學期我要早睡早起、按時交作業、認真做筆記。
開學第二天：我在騙誰啊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學立志文的標準反差，第二天就破功時發，全班秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的新學期目標，通常活不過第一個週末。」
進階版：「每學期開學我都重開機一次，然後照樣當機。」

en.content:
Day one of the semester: this term I'm sleeping early, submitting on time, taking real notes.
Day two: who am I kidding.
en.editorNote: The classic start-of-term resolution that collapses by day two — post it the second reality hits.
variations: Swap in: "My new-semester goals usually don't survive the first weekend."
Harder mode: "Every semester I reboot myself, then crash exactly like before."

items.sourceNote: 'staring at notes until knowledge transfers via osmosis' 滲透式讀書梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我的考前讀書法很科學：
把書放在胸口睡覺，希望知識能自己滲透進來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前臨時抱佛腳、根本沒讀進去時發文，同溫層集體認領。
variations: 也能換成：「課本壓在枕頭下，我賭的是它會自動上傳到夢裡。」
進階版：「我不是沒讀書，我是在等知識主動來找我。」

en.content:
My pre-exam study method is very scientific:
I sleep with the textbook on my chest and hope the knowledge just soaks in.
en.editorNote: For last-minute cramming that never actually lands — your whole friend group will claim it.
variations: Swap in: "Textbook under the pillow — I'm betting it auto-uploads into my dreams."
Harder mode: "It's not that I didn't study, I'm waiting for the knowledge to come to me."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 大學生 上課打瞌睡 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
我不是在上課睡著，
我只是在用閉眼的方式，深度思考老師剛剛講的內容。
zh-tw.editorNote: 上課秒睡被抓包後的嘴硬式解釋，坐後排的同學最有感。
variations: 也能換成：「我沒有打瞌睡，我是在做眼球保養。」
進階版：「教室後排不是座位，是一整排大型充電站。」

en.content:
I wasn't asleep in class,
I was just deeply reflecting on the lecture with my eyes closed.
en.editorNote: The stubborn excuse after getting caught dozing off — back-row students feel this hardest.
variations: Swap in: "I wasn't napping, I was doing eye maintenance."
Harder mode: "The back row isn't seating, it's a whole row of charging stations."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 開學季選課甜涼課 搶不到 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
選課系統開放的那一刻，
我才發現我的手速，配不上我想涼的心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 加退選搶不到甜涼課、被系統打敗時發文，同屆同學都懂那種痛。
variations: 也能換成：「甜涼課的名額，比演唱會搖滾區還快沒。」
進階版：「課表是別人幫我排的，因為我想選的全都額滿了。」

en.content:
The moment course registration opened,
I realized my typing speed can't keep up with how badly I want an easy class.
en.editorNote: For getting shut out of the easy-A classes on registration day — same-year students know the pain.
variations: Swap in: "Easy-class spots run out faster than front-row concert tickets."
Harder mode: "My schedule was basically picked for me, because everything I wanted was full."

items.sourceNote: 'studying is 10% reading and 90% crying about reading' 讀書比例梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
所謂讀書，其實只有百分之十在讀，
剩下百分之九十，是在為還沒讀的部分焦慮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 翻開書卻越讀越慌時發文，準備考試的同學會回「太真實」。
variations: 也能換成：「我讀書的時間，八成花在滑手機找讀書的動力。」
進階版：「我不是在讀書，我是在陪書坐著，順便一起崩潰。」

en.content:
Studying is really just ten percent reading,
and the other ninety percent is stressing about the part I haven't read yet.
en.editorNote: Post it when opening the book only makes you more anxious — fellow exam-preppers will reply 'too real'.
variations: Swap in: "Eighty percent of my study time goes to scrolling for the motivation to study."
Harder mode: "I'm not studying, I'm just keeping the book company while we both fall apart."

items.sourceNote: 'I'm not procrastinating, I'm doing side quests before the main mission' 支線任務梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我不是在拖延，
我只是在正式開始讀書這個主線任務前，先把所有支線任務都刷完。
zh-tw.editorNote: 書擺在旁邊卻先去整理房間、追劇時發文，拖延同好會集體點頭。
variations: 也能換成：「主線我一定會破，只是要等支線的房間先掃乾淨、手機先滑完。」
進階版：「我的讀書進度是零，但我的『準備讀書』完成度已經百分之百。」

en.content:
I'm not procrastinating,
I'm just clearing every side quest before I start the main mission of actually studying.
en.editorNote: Post it when the textbook sits there while you tidy your room or binge a show — fellow procrastinators will nod along.
variations: Swap in: "I'll finish the main quest eventually, I just have to clean the room and finish scrolling first."
Harder mode: "My study progress is zero, but my 'getting ready to study' is one hundred percent complete."

items.sourceNote: '3 a.m. just one more page, 7 a.m. why am I like this' 熬夜心境轉折梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點的我還在說「再一頁就好」，
早上七點的我只想問「我到底為什麼要把自己搞成這樣」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 通宵趕報告到天亮、看到日出時發文，熬夜戰友會秒回同款崩潰。
variations: 也能換成：「熬夜的時候覺得自己是狠角色，天亮之後只覺得自己是災難。」
進階版：「我不是在熬夜，我是在跟明天的自己借命。」

en.content:
At 3 a.m. I'm still saying "just one more page,"
and at 7 a.m. I'm just asking "why do I do this to myself?"
en.editorNote: Post it when you've pulled an all-nighter on an assignment and watched the sunrise — fellow night owls will reply with the same meltdown.
variations: Swap in: "At night I feel like a legend, by morning I just feel like a disaster."
Harder mode: "I'm not staying up late, I'm borrowing life from tomorrow-me."

items.sourceNote: 'tired, broke, and laughing through the pain' 學生窮困伙食梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
月底的我很懂養生：
因為冰箱裡只剩下泡麵、白飯，和一顆放到有感情的雞蛋。
zh-tw.editorNote: 月底錢包見底、只能省吃儉用時發文，同樣月光的同學會苦笑認領。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是在減肥，我只是在配合我的存款一起瘦。」
進階版：「學餐漲五塊，我一個月的財務規劃就全毀了。」

en.content:
By the end of the month I'm really into clean eating —
because all that's left in the fridge is instant noodles, plain rice, and one egg I've grown emotionally attached to.
en.editorNote: Post it when your wallet's empty at month's end and you're rationing food — broke classmates will claim it with a bitter smile.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not on a diet, I'm just slimming down in solidarity with my bank balance."
Harder mode: "The dining hall raised prices by a buck and my whole monthly budget collapsed."

items.sourceNote: 'Due tomorrow? More like do tomorrow' 明天交明天做梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
作業明天要交？
那不就剛好可以明天再做，時間算得剛剛好嘛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 看到 deadline 卻毫不緊張、繼續拖的人專用，貼群組會有一堆人對號入座。
variations: 也能換成：「deadline 不是壓力，是提醒我可以再耍廢一天的鬧鐘。」
進階版：「我從來不會提早做，因為我相信『最後一刻』從不遲到。」

en.content:
Due tomorrow?
That just means I can do it tomorrow — the timing works out perfectly.
en.editorNote: For the student who sees a deadline and feels zero panic — drop it in the chat and half the group will recognize themselves.
variations: Swap in: "A deadline isn't pressure, it's an alarm reminding me I get one more day to slack off."
Harder mode: "I never start early, because I trust that 'the last minute' always shows up on time."

items.sourceNote: 學期初教材全新、學期末照樣全新 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
學期初我花大錢買了全新的課本，
學期末它還是全新的——連我都佩服自己保存得這麼好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 課本買了整學期沒翻、期末退書時發文，買了沒讀的同學都懂那個尷尬。
variations: 也能換成：「這本書唯一被翻開的一次，是我拍照上網二手拍賣的時候。」
進階版：「教材我沒讀，但書套包得整整齊齊，這也是一種認真吧。」

en.content:
At the start of the semester I spent a fortune on a brand-new textbook,
and at the end it's still brand new — honestly I'm impressed at how well I preserved it.
en.editorNote: Post it when the textbook you bought went untouched all term — anyone who buys books and never reads them knows the awkwardness.
variations: Swap in: "The only time this book got opened was when I photographed it to resell it."
Harder mode: "I never read the textbook, but the cover's perfectly wrapped — that counts as trying, right?"

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
別人考前複習一整個月，我考前複習一整個晚上，
我們最後拿到的分數證明了——時間根本不是重點，命才是。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期中期末臨時抱佛腳、熬夜硬讀一晚就進考場時發文，考運派同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是沒念書，我只是把整學期的進度濃縮成一個晚上，很有效率好嗎。」
進階版：「複習範圍：全部。實際念到的：第一頁跟祝我好運。」

en.content:
Other people study for a whole month before the exam. I study for one whole night.
Our final grades proved one thing: time isn't the factor — luck is.
en.editorNote: Post it after cramming all night and walking into the exam — the pray-and-pass crowd feels this.
variations: Swap in: "I did study. I just compressed the entire semester into one night. That's called efficiency."
Harder mode: "Review scope: everything. Actually reviewed: page one and a silent prayer."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
分組報告最公平的地方，就是無論你做多少，
最後大家的分數都一樣——包括那個到現在還沒進群組的同學。
zh-tw.editorNote: 扛完整組報告、看到雷隊友照樣拿一樣分數時發文，做過主揪的都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「這組只有我一個人在做，但成員欄有五個名字，很神奇吧。」
進階版：「隊友已讀不回三週，交件前一小時傳來一句『我這部分要做什麼』。」

en.content:
The fairest thing about group projects is that no matter how much you do,
everyone gets the same grade — including the guy who still hasn't joined the group chat.
en.editorNote: Post it after carrying the whole project and watching the dead weight get the same grade — every project leader knows this pain.
variations: Swap in: "I'm the only one doing this project, but the member list has five names. Fascinating."
Harder mode: "Teammate left me on read for three weeks, then messaged an hour before the deadline: 'wait, what's my part?'"

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
我報名這堂早八的時候，是真心以為我會變成一個早起的人。
事實證明，我只是多買了一堂看不到的課。
zh-tw.editorNote: 選課時對早八充滿幻想、開學後全數翹掉時發文，被早八背刺過的都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「早八教室裡最熟悉的臉，是投影幕上教授的簡報，因為我只看過那個。」
進階版：「我跟早八的關係很穩定——它每週準時開課，我每週準時錯過。」

en.content:
When I signed up for that 8 a.m. class, I genuinely believed I'd become an early riser.
Turns out I just bought a class I'd never actually see.
en.editorNote: Post it after fantasizing about the 8 a.m. slot at registration and then skipping every single one — anyone burned by early classes gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The most familiar face in that 8 a.m. room is the professor's slides, because that's all I've ever seen of it."
Harder mode: "My relationship with the 8 a.m. class is very stable — it starts on time every week, and I miss it on time every week."

items.sourceNote: 'eating cereal for dinner at 2 AM' 學生宵夜亂吃梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
只有在大學，凌晨兩點邊寫報告邊配一碗麥片當晚餐，
才會被當成一件完全正常的事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 熬夜趕作業、三餐時間全亂掉時發文，宵夜配報告的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的三餐時間，是報告的截止時間決定的。」
進階版：「大學教會我，餓的時候手邊有什麼，那就是正餐。」

en.content:
Only in college is eating a bowl of cereal for dinner at 2 a.m. while writing a paper
treated as a completely normal thing to do.
en.editorNote: Post it when your meal times fall apart during an all-nighter — anyone pairing snacks with assignments gets it.
variations: Swap in: "My meal schedule is set entirely by assignment deadlines."
Harder mode: "College taught me that whatever's within reach when I'm hungry counts as a real meal."

items.sourceNote: 'my GPA and my will to live have the same trend line' 曲線同步梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
這學期我的 GPA 和我的求生意志，
畫出來是同一條往下掉的線。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績越來越低、整個人越來越厭世時發文，準備看成績單的同學會苦笑。
variations: 也能換成：「我的分數跟我的心情，最近默契好到同進同退。」
進階版：「教授說要看趨勢，我看了，趨勢是往地心去。」

en.content:
This semester my GPA and my will to live
plot out as the exact same line heading down.
en.editorNote: Post it when your grades keep dropping and so does your soul — grade-check dread crowd will smile bitterly.
variations: Swap in: "My grades and my mood have been so in sync lately, they rise and fall together."
Harder mode: "The professor said to watch the trend. I watched. The trend is heading for the earth's core."

items.sourceNote: 'Dear exam, please be as easy as my professor said' 沒讀書祈禱梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
親愛的考卷，拜託你像教授說的那樣簡單，
祝好。——一個完全沒準備的學生敬上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前完全裸考、只能靠祈禱時發文，同樣沒念書的同學會秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的考前準備，就是誠心祈禱考題全都考我剛好會的那一頁。」
進階版：「教授說『這題很基本』，我聽完的反應是我可能要重修了。」

en.content:
Dear exam, please be as easy as my professor promised.
Sincerely, a student who didn't study a thing.
en.editorNote: Post it before walking into an exam completely unprepared and running on prayers — fellow non-studiers get it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "My exam prep is sincerely praying that every question is on the one page I happen to know."
Harder mode: "The professor said 'this one is basic,' and my honest reaction was that I might be retaking this."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 大學生 靠同學筆記過活 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
這學期我能順利活到期末，
全靠一個從來沒翹過課、又願意分享筆記的好人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 靠同學筆記混過整學期時發文，感謝那位班上救世主，同款寄生的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我不去上課沒關係，因為我認識一個會去上課的朋友。」
進階版：「別人的筆記是筆記，我朋友的筆記是我這學期的命脈。」

en.content:
The only reason I'll make it to finals this semester
is one good soul who never skips class and actually shares their notes.
en.editorNote: Post it when you've survived a whole term on a classmate's notes — a tribute to the class savior every freeloader relies on.
variations: Swap in: "It's fine that I skip class, because I know a friend who doesn't."
Harder mode: "Other people's notes are just notes; my friend's notes are my lifeline this semester."

items.sourceNote: 'same crippling fear of the participation grade' 平時分焦慮梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
新學期，一樣的教室，一樣對「平時成績」的恐懼，
因為我知道那三個字，翻譯成白話就是「你到底有沒有開口」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 怕被點名發言、平時分全靠緣分的同學專用，開學或期中發最有感。
variations: 也能換成：「平時分是我這學期最不平時的壓力來源。」
進階版：「教授說『平時多發言』，我發的言只有心裡的『拜託不要點到我』。」

en.content:
New semester, same classroom, same crippling fear of the "participation grade" —
because I know those two words really just mean "did you ever open your mouth or not."
en.editorNote: For students terrified of being called on, whose participation grade runs entirely on luck. Best at term start or midterms.
variations: Swap in: "The participation grade is the least casual source of stress I have all semester."
Harder mode: "The professor says 'speak up more,' and the only thing I say is a silent 'please don't call on me.'"

items.sourceNote: 'this syllabus is a contract / I didn't read my phone contract either' 課綱合約梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
教授說：「這份課綱等於一份合約，大家務必看清楚。」
沒問題，反正我連手機合約都沒看過就簽了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 第一堂課發課綱、看都沒看就收起來時發文，標準廢話文學句型，同學會回「太真實」。
variations: 也能換成：「課綱我當然有看，看的是第一頁跟最後的評分比例。」
進階版：「課綱寫得越詳細，代表這堂課越不好混，我懂了。」

en.content:
Professor: "This syllabus is basically a contract, so read it carefully."
No problem — I didn't read my phone contract before signing that either.
en.editorNote: Post it on the first day when you pocket the syllabus without reading a word — classic nonsense-literature format, friends will reply 'too real'.
variations: Swap in: "Of course I read the syllabus — the first page and the grade breakdown at the end."
Harder mode: "The more detailed the syllabus, the harder the class is to coast through. Message received."

items.sourceNote: 通勤生早八通勤 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
同學走路五分鐘到教室，我通勤一個半小時，
所以早八對我來說不是早八，是早六。
zh-tw.editorNote: 外宿或通勤生的真實崩潰，配一張擠捷運或公車的照片最有畫面。
variations: 也能換成：「我一天最認真的時段，是趕那班不能錯過的公車。」
進階版：「通勤族的早八，是從鬧鐘響的那一刻就開始上課了。」

en.content:
My classmates walk five minutes to class; I commute an hour and a half,
so for me an 8 a.m. class isn't an 8 a.m. — it's a 6 a.m.
en.editorNote: A real meltdown for commuter students — most vivid next to a photo of a packed train or bus.
variations: Swap in: "The most disciplined part of my day is catching the one bus I can't afford to miss."
Harder mode: "For a commuter, the 8 a.m. class starts the second the alarm goes off."

items.sourceNote: 'Grades are posted. Time to enter witness protection' 成績出爐躲起來梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
成績公布了，
接下來這段時間，我決定進入證人保護計畫，等下學期再重新做人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績出爐後不想面對世界時發文，一起考爛的同學會秒回同款想消失。
variations: 也能換成：「成績單一出來，我的社交電量瞬間歸零。」
進階版：「別找我，我正在跟這學期的自己斷絕關係。」

en.content:
Grades are posted,
so for the foreseeable future I'll be entering witness protection and starting fresh as a person next semester.
en.editorNote: Post it when grades drop and you can't face the world — classmates who bombed too will reply with the same urge to vanish.
variations: Swap in: "The second the grades came out, my social battery hit zero."
Harder mode: "Don't look for me, I'm officially cutting ties with this semester's version of myself."

items.sourceNote: 'motivated to overwhelmed to dead inside to reborn during break' 學期情緒四階段梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我的一個學期分成四種心情：
開學的鬥志滿滿、期中的喘不過氣、期末的形同虛設，然後放假的原地復活。
zh-tw.editorNote: 回顧整學期心境起伏時發文，適合期末考完或放假第一天總結用。
variations: 也能換成：「學期初的我和放假的我，中間隔了一整條崩潰的曲線。」
進階版：「我這學期唯一的成長曲線，是心情從滿格掉到沒電的那條。」

en.content:
My semester comes in four moods:
fired up at the start, gasping for air at midterms, completely dead inside by finals, and back from the grave once break begins.
en.editorNote: Post it when looking back on a whole term's emotional rollercoaster — great for right after finals or day one of break.
variations: Swap in: "The me at the start of term and the me on break are separated by one long meltdown curve."
Harder mode: "The only growth curve I had this semester was my mood draining from full to empty."

items.sourceNote: 'confidence level: Kanye, actual knowledge: potato' 自信與實力落差梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
進考場前的自信程度：頂天。
翻開考卷後的實際實力：一顆馬鈴薯。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前莫名有信心、看到題目瞬間清醒時發文，裸考同學會笑著認領。
variations: 也能換成：「我的氣勢可以拿滿分，可惜考的是內容不是氣勢。」
進階版：「走進去像要征服世界，走出來只想找個地洞。」

en.content:
Confidence level walking into the exam: through the roof.
Actual knowledge after flipping the paper over: one potato.
en.editorNote: Post it when you feel weirdly confident before an exam and get instantly humbled by the questions — the wing-it crowd will claim it with a laugh.
variations: Swap in: "My swagger could ace this test, shame it grades content and not swagger."
Harder mode: "Walked in ready to conquer the world, walked out looking for a hole to crawl into."

items.sourceNote: 'I owe my diploma to coffee, Google, and the kid with good notes' 畢業感謝名單梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
如果我真的能畢業，
我要感謝的是咖啡、Google，還有那個坐我前面、筆記做得很好的同學。
zh-tw.editorNote: 回顧大學怎麼混到畢業時發文，靠外援存活的同學都懂這份感謝名單。
variations: 也能換成：「我的畢業證書，一半是我努力，一半是我朋友的雲端硬碟。」
進階版：「教授教會我知識，Google 教會我怎麼在期末前一天學會那些知識。」

en.content:
If I actually manage to graduate,
I'd like to thank coffee, Google, and the kid who sat in front of me with really good notes.
en.editorNote: Post it when reflecting on how you coasted to graduation — anyone who survived on outside help knows this thank-you list.
variations: Swap in: "Half of my diploma is my effort, the other half is my friend's cloud drive."
Harder mode: "The professor taught me the material, Google taught me how to learn it the night before finals."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 大學生寫 email 給教授的焦慮 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
一封給教授的 email，我可以打十分鐘、刪五次、改到第八版，
最後傳出去的還是「老師您好，不好意思打擾了」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 寫信給教授前反覆糾結、開頭刪掉重打十次的同學專用，社恐學生秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我寫 email 給教授的謹慎程度，遠超過我寫報告的程度。」
進階版：「『敬祝　教安』這四個字，是我整封信裡最有把握的部分。」

en.content:
One email to a professor takes me ten minutes, five deletes, and eight drafts,
and what finally goes out is still just "Dear Professor, sorry to bother you."
en.editorNote: For the student who agonizes over emailing a professor, rewriting the opening ten times — socially anxious students get it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "I'm far more careful writing an email to my professor than writing the actual assignment."
Harder mode: "'Best regards' is the only part of the whole email I'm actually sure about."

items.sourceNote: 'it's not procrastination during finals week, it's survival' 期末拖延即生存梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
期末週的拖延不叫拖延，
那叫在崩潰邊緣，用滑手機幫自己續命。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末該讀書卻一直逃避、靠耍廢喘口氣時發文，同樣在邊緣的同學會秒回。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是在浪費時間，我是在為即將到來的崩潰做心理建設。」
進階版：「期末週我最勤勞的，是每五分鐘檢查一次還剩幾天。」

en.content:
Procrastinating during finals week isn't procrastination,
it's using my phone to keep myself alive on the edge of a breakdown.
en.editorNote: Post it when you keep dodging studying during finals and slack off just to catch your breath — fellow students on the brink will reply instantly.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not wasting time, I'm mentally preparing for the meltdown that's coming."
Harder mode: "The hardest I work during finals week is checking how many days are left every five minutes."

items.sourceNote: 'highlighting the whole page so now everything is important' 螢光筆整頁畫滿假讀書梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我拿螢光筆把整頁都畫滿，
這樣每個重點都是重點，也等於沒有重點，但至少看起來很認真。
zh-tw.editorNote: 拿螢光筆狂畫、畫完卻什麼都沒記住時發文，愛用文具營造讀書感的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我對讀書的貢獻，主要集中在把文具擺得很整齊這件事上。」
進階版：「螢光筆換了三種顏色，內容還是一個字都沒進腦袋。」

en.content:
I highlighted the entire page,
so now every point is a key point, which means none of them are — but at least it looks like I'm trying.
en.editorNote: Post it when you go wild with a highlighter and remember nothing afterward — anyone who studies via stationery aesthetics gets it.
variations: Swap in: "My main contribution to studying is arranging my stationery very neatly."
Harder mode: "I cycled through three highlighter colors and still nothing made it into my brain."

items.sourceNote: 線上課鏡頭關掉掛網 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
線上課我一定準時進教室，
只是進去之後，鏡頭關掉、麥克風關掉、連我這個人也一起關機。
zh-tw.editorNote: 線上課掛帳號人卻不在時發文，鏡頭永遠黑畫面的同學會心虛地認領。
variations: 也能換成：「老師問『大家有跟上嗎』的時候，我人在廚房煮泡麵。」
進階版：「我出席率百分之百，實際在聽的比例接近零。」

en.content:
For online class I always log in right on time —
I just turn off the camera, turn off the mic, and turn myself off too.
en.editorNote: Post it when your account is present but you aren't — anyone whose camera stays a black square will sheepishly claim it.
variations: Swap in: "When the teacher asks 'is everyone following along,' I'm in the kitchen making noodles."
Harder mode: "My attendance rate is one hundred percent; the share I actually listen to is close to zero."

items.sourceNote: 上台報告完最怕台下Q&A 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
上台報告最恐怖的不是講的那十分鐘，
是講完之後，教授那句「台下有沒有問題」的三秒鐘死寂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 報告完等 Q&A、深怕被問倒時發文，怕上台的同學都懂那種心跳漏拍。
variations: 也能換成：「我準備報告花了三天，準備『被問問題』花了我一整條命。」
進階版：「拜託大家不要舉手，我的稿只寫到謝謝聆聽為止。」

en.content:
The scariest part of presenting isn't the ten minutes of talking,
it's the three seconds of dead silence after, when the professor asks, "any questions from the floor?"
en.editorNote: Post it while waiting out the Q&A, terrified of being stumped — anyone who dreads presenting knows that skipped heartbeat.
variations: Swap in: "I spent three days prepping the talk and a whole life force prepping to 'get asked a question.'"
Harder mode: "Please, nobody raise a hand — my script ends at 'thank you for listening.'"

items.sourceNote: 週日晚上收心憂鬱 每週循環梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
週日晚上八點，是一個星期裡最短的時段，
它前一秒還是假日，下一秒就變成明天要上課的倒數計時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 週日晚上收心症候群發作時發文，每週固定憂鬱一次的學生都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的週末只有兩天，但憂鬱從星期天下午就開始預購了。」
進階版：「星期五的我和星期日晚上的我，是同一個人生的兩種版本。」

en.content:
8 p.m. on Sunday is the shortest stretch of the whole week:
one second it's still the weekend, the next it's a countdown to class tomorrow.
en.editorNote: Post it when the Sunday-night scaries kick in — every student who gets sad on schedule once a week understands.
variations: Swap in: "My weekend is only two days, but the dread goes on pre-order by Sunday afternoon."
Harder mode: "Friday me and Sunday-night me are two different editions of the same life."

items.sourceNote: 'homework is like a bad ex, it keeps coming back' 作業像前任梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
作業很像前任，
你以為終於解脫了，下一秒它又換個名字回來找你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 剛交完一份作業、下一份馬上來報到時發文，被作業追著跑的同學會苦笑。
variations: 也能換成：「我剛送走一份報告，還沒喘口氣，第二份就已經在門口敲門了。」
進階版：「作業從來不會結束，它只會換一個科目繼續糾纏我。」

en.content:
Homework is a lot like an ex:
just when you think you're finally free, it comes back under a new name.
en.editorNote: Post it when you submit one assignment and the next lands immediately — students who live one deadline ahead will smile bitterly.
variations: Swap in: "I just saw off one report, and before I could breathe the second was already knocking at the door."
Harder mode: "Homework never ends — it just switches to a different subject and keeps haunting me."

items.sourceNote: 'my brain is 90% song lyrics and 10% exam knowledge' 腦袋內容比例梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
考試的時候我才發現，我的腦袋有九成裝的是廣告歌跟迷因，
剩下那一成，剛好不是這次要考的範圍。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考試腦袋一片空白、只想得起無關的東西時發文，裸考同學都懂那種被自己背叛的感覺。
variations: 也能換成：「該記的公式一個都想不起來，反倒是十年前的廣告詞背得滾瓜爛熟。」
進階版：「我的記憶體很滿，只是存的全是這輩子用不到的東西。」

en.content:
During the exam I realized my brain is ninety percent jingles and memes,
and the remaining ten percent is conveniently not what's on this test.
en.editorNote: Post it when your mind goes blank and only useless trivia shows up — the wing-it crowd knows that feeling of being betrayed by your own head.
variations: Swap in: "I can't recall a single formula I needed, but I've got a ten-year-old ad slogan memorized cold."
Harder mode: "My memory is completely full — it's just full of stuff I'll never use."

items.sourceNote: 揪讀書會變成聊天大會 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
我們約好去圖書館一起讀書，
結果三個小時過去，書一頁沒翻，八卦倒是更新到最新進度。
zh-tw.editorNote: 揪朋友讀書卻整場都在聊天時發文，號稱一起唸書其實一起耍廢的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「一個人讀書會分心，一群人讀書會直接開成同學會。」
進階版：「我們的讀書會唯一讀完的，是彼此的近況。」

en.content:
We agreed to study together at the library,
and three hours later not a single page was turned, but the gossip is fully up to date.
en.editorNote: Post it when a study session with friends turns into pure chatting — anyone who 'studies together' but slacks together gets it.
variations: Swap in: "Studying alone gets me distracted; studying in a group turns straight into a class reunion."
Harder mode: "The only thing our study group finished reading was each other's life updates."

items.sourceNote: 選課看網路評價結果踩雷 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
選課前我把每一則課程評價都研究得透透的，
開學才發現，寫「輕鬆好過」的那個人，一定跟我修的不是同一門課。
zh-tw.editorNote: 照著網路評價選課、結果慘踩雷時發文，被「甜涼佛」三個字騙過的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「網路上說這堂很涼，我上完只覺得，涼的是我的成績。」
進階版：「課程評價這種東西，跟商品照片一樣，僅供參考、與實物不符。」

en.content:
Before registering I studied every single course review inside out,
only to find out on day one that whoever wrote "easy and chill" clearly took a different class than I did.
en.editorNote: Post it when you pick a class off online reviews and hit a total landmine — anyone fooled by an 'easy-A' rating knows the pain.
variations: Swap in: "The internet said this class was chill; after finishing it, the only thing chilled was my grade."
Harder mode: "Course reviews are like product photos — for reference only, may differ from the actual item."

items.sourceNote: 快畢業卻對未來迷茫焦慮 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
越接近畢業，我越焦慮，
因為學校至少會告訴我下一堂課在哪，而人生的課表，到現在還是一片空白。
zh-tw.editorNote: 快畢業卻對未來一片迷茫時發文，站在校園出口前不知道下一步的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「以前煩惱期末考，現在煩惱畢業後要面對的是哪一種人生的考試。」
進階版：「畢業不是終點，是把我從有課表的世界，一腳踢進沒有標準答案的地方。」

en.content:
The closer I get to graduating, the more anxious I feel,
because school at least tells me where my next class is — my life's schedule is still completely blank.
en.editorNote: Post it when graduation looms and the future is a total blur — anyone standing at the campus exit with no idea what's next gets it.
variations: Swap in: "I used to stress about finals; now I stress about what kind of life exam comes after graduation."
Harder mode: "Graduation isn't a finish line, it's getting kicked out of a world with a class schedule into one with no right answers."

items.sourceNote: 'exams test your ability to panic gracefully' 優雅崩潰梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
考試從來不是在測驗我會不會，
是在測驗我能不能在完全不會的情況下，還坐得住兩個小時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考卷一發下來全是不會的、只能硬撐時間的瞬間發文，裸考同學都懂那種強顏鎮定。
variations: 也能換成：「這場考試考的不是實力，是我崩潰時還能不能維持表面的平靜。」
進階版：「我不是在答題，我是在跟一張我完全不熟的考卷，禮貌地大眼瞪小眼。」

en.content:
An exam was never testing whether I know the material,
it's testing whether I can sit still for two hours while knowing absolutely none of it.
en.editorNote: Post it the moment the paper lands and it's all unfamiliar — the wing-it crowd knows that forced calm.
variations: Swap in: "This exam isn't testing my knowledge, it's testing if I can stay composed while quietly falling apart."
Harder mode: "I'm not answering questions, I'm politely staring down a paper I've never met before."

items.sourceNote: 'Dear sleep, finals said we can't be together' 睡眠負債情書梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
睡眠啊，我很想你，
但期末說我們這陣子不能在一起，等我熬完這幾週，一定回去找你。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末連續熬夜、睡眠嚴重不足時發文，欠了一屁股睡眠債的同學都懂那種思念。
variations: 也能換成：「我跟睡眠是遠距離戀愛，見一次面要排到考完試以後。」
進階版：「別人是睡飽再努力，我是努力到沒得睡，再假裝自己很清醒。」

en.content:
Dear sleep, I really miss you,
but finals said we can't be together right now — once I survive these weeks, I promise I'll come back to you.
en.editorNote: Post it during a finals-week sleep-deprivation streak — anyone deep in sleep debt knows the longing.
variations: Swap in: "Me and sleep are in a long-distance relationship — the next visit isn't until after exams."
Harder mode: "Other people rest up before they grind; I grind until there's no sleep left, then fake being awake."

items.sourceNote: 'buying new stationery feels like studying' 買文具當讀書梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我為了這次考試準備得超齊全：
新的筆記本、五種顏色的螢光筆、還有一顆完全沒打算翻開課本的心。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前狂買文具、佈置書桌卻一頁沒讀時發文，靠買文具獲得虛假成就感的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的讀書進度是零，但我的文具收藏又完整了一階。」
進階版：「筆記本挑得很用心，內容一片空白——這叫留白美學。」

en.content:
I'm fully prepared for this exam:
a new notebook, five colors of highlighters, and absolutely no intention of opening the textbook.
en.editorNote: Post it when you buy a haul of stationery and set up your desk but read zero pages — the fake-productivity crowd gets it.
variations: Swap in: "My study progress is zero, but my stationery collection just leveled up."
Harder mode: "Picked the notebook with great care, left the pages completely blank — call it the art of negative space."

items.sourceNote: 老師說自由分組 社恐現場 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
全班最讓我心跳加速的一句話，
不是「這個要考」，是老師笑著說的那句「來，自由分組」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 老師宣布自由分組、當場不知道要跟誰一組時發文，班上沒什麼熟人的社恐同學秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「自由分組的『自由』，是給有朋友的人用的，我只有自由地站在原地。」
進階版：「老師說自由分組的那三秒，我把整間教室的天花板都研究透了。」

en.content:
The sentence that spikes my heart rate the most in class
isn't "this will be on the test" — it's the professor cheerfully saying, "okay, form your own groups."
en.editorNote: Post it when the prof announces free groups and you have no idea who to join — every socially anxious student with no close classmates gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The 'free' in 'form your own groups' is for people with friends — I just freely stand there alone."
Harder mode: "In the three seconds after the prof said 'pick your groups,' I studied every inch of the ceiling."

items.sourceNote: 待辦清單越列越長一個沒做 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
我的手機備忘錄裡有一份完美的待辦清單，
它唯一的問題，就是從列出來的那天起，一項都沒被打勾過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 列了一堆待辦、卻一件都沒動時發文，用清單假裝自己很有規劃的拖延同好都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我很會列待辦，只是不太會『辦』那個部分。」
進階版：「列清單的當下最有生產力，因為那是我唯一真的做完的一件事。」

en.content:
There's a perfect to-do list sitting in my phone's notes app,
and its only flaw is that not a single item has been checked off since the day I wrote it.
en.editorNote: Post it when your list keeps growing but nothing gets done — fellow procrastinators who plan instead of act will claim it.
variations: Swap in: "I'm great at making to-do lists, I'm just not great at the 'do' part."
Harder mode: "Writing the list is peak productivity, because it's the only thing on it I actually finish."

items.sourceNote: 'wrote a whole essay and realized it was for the wrong class' 熬夜寫錯科目梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我熬夜熬到天亮，把整篇報告寫完、檢查完、還存了三個備份，
結果早上才發現，這份作業是別科的，這禮拜根本不用交。
zh-tw.editorNote: 熬夜做錯作業、白忙一整晚時發文，看錯課表或搞錯 deadline 的同學都懂那種崩潰。
variations: 也能換成：「我用一整晚換來的成就感，在看到正確作業清單的那秒瞬間蒸發。」
進階版：「我不是效率高，我是先把不用交的那份寫完了。」

en.content:
I pulled an all-nighter, finished the whole essay, proofread it, and saved three backups —
then at sunrise I realized it was for a different class and wasn't even due this week.
en.editorNote: Post it after grinding all night on the wrong assignment — anyone who misread their schedule or mixed up a deadline knows the despair.
variations: Swap in: "The sense of accomplishment I earned overnight vanished the second I saw the correct assignment list."
Harder mode: "I'm not efficient, I just finished the one that wasn't due first."

items.sourceNote: 'broke, overworked, sleep-deprived isn't a crisis, it's a personality' 學生窮忙人設梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
又窮、又忙、又睡不飽，
這對別人來說可能是危機，對我來說，這已經是我的人設了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 身心俱疲卻自嘲得很淡定時發文，被生活磨到麻木的大學生會苦笑認領。
variations: 也能換成：「別人問我最近好不好，我說我很穩定，穩定地窮、穩定地累。」
進階版：「我不是狀態不好，我只是把『撐著』活成了一種日常。」

en.content:
Broke, overworked, and running on no sleep —
for other people that might be a crisis, but for me it's just my whole personality now.
en.editorNote: Post it when you're wrecked but deadpan about it — students numbed by daily grind will claim it with a bitter smile.
variations: Swap in: "When people ask how I'm doing, I say I'm stable — stably broke, stably exhausted."
Harder mode: "I'm not in a bad state, I've just turned 'barely hanging on' into a lifestyle."

items.sourceNote: 'keep calm and pretend you know what you're doing' 假裝聽得懂梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我在大學學到最實用的技能，
不是任何一門專業，是「完全聽不懂但點頭點得很有自信」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 課堂討論、開會一頭霧水卻硬撐氣場時發文，靠演技混過場面的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「教授講到一半問『大家理解嗎』，我第一個點頭，也是唯一沒理解的那個。」
進階版：「我的專業能力普通，但『假裝我很懂』這項已經滿等了。」

en.content:
The most useful skill I picked up in college
wasn't any of my major courses — it's "nodding with total confidence while understanding nothing."
en.editorNote: Post it when you're lost in a discussion or meeting but keep up the front — anyone coasting on acting skills gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The professor paused to ask 'does everyone follow?' — I nodded first, and I was also the only one who didn't follow."
Harder mode: "My actual expertise is average, but my 'pretending I get it' is fully maxed out."

items.sourceNote: 'the moment when all of your knowledge magically disappears' 考試知識蒸發、交卷後回來梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
考試最玄的地方是，鈴聲一響，我腦中的知識就集體人間蒸發，
等我交完卷走出教室，它們才一個一個慢慢回來報到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考試當下腦袋一片空白、交卷後才想起答案時發文，經歷過那種懊悔的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「考卷上想不起來的答案，全都在走出考場那條走廊上等我。」
進階版：「我不是不會，我是把會的時間點抓得剛好錯開了考試。」

en.content:
The eeriest thing about exams is that the second the bell rings, all my knowledge magically disappears,
and only after I hand in the paper and walk out do the answers come strolling back one by one.
en.editorNote: Post it when your mind blanks during the exam and the answers return the moment you leave — anyone who's felt that regret gets it.
variations: Swap in: "Every answer I couldn't recall on the paper was waiting for me in the hallway outside."
Harder mode: "It's not that I don't know it, I just timed knowing it to perfectly miss the exam."

items.sourceNote: 'finals week is like a middle finger from the universe' 期末所有事撞同一週梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我一直懷疑期末週是宇宙特地挑的時間，
它把整學期的報告、考試、繳交期限，全部塞進同一個禮拜還給我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末所有 deadline 撞在同一週、被壓到喘不過氣時發文，全班都會回同款慘叫。
variations: 也能換成：「這學期該做的事我都沒做，它們很有默契地約好在同一週來找我算帳。」
進階版：「期末週不是一週，是一整學期的帳單集中在七天內一次結清。」

en.content:
I'm convinced finals week is a time the universe picked on purpose,
cramming an entire semester's worth of papers, exams, and deadlines into one single week and handing it all back to me.
en.editorNote: Post it when every deadline collides in the same week and you can't breathe — the whole class will reply with the same scream.
variations: Swap in: "Everything I put off all semester agreed to come collect on the same week."
Harder mode: "Finals week isn't a week, it's a whole semester's bill settled in seven days."

items.sourceNote: 報告湊字數 調行距字級 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
教授要求報告至少三千字，
我實際有東西可寫的只有八百字，剩下的兩千二，是靠行距、標點和廢話堆出來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 報告字數差一大截、只能硬湊時發文，寫過期末報告的同學都懂那種掙扎。
variations: 也能換成：「我這篇報告的精華在前五百字，後面全是在幫它增重。」
進階版：「字數不夠的時候，連『綜上所述』都能被我拆成三段來寫。」

en.content:
The professor wants at least three thousand words.
I have maybe eight hundred words of actual content — the other twenty-two hundred are built out of line spacing, punctuation, and pure filler.
en.editorNote: Post it when your paper is way under the count and you're padding hard — anyone who's written a term paper knows the struggle.
variations: Swap in: "The good part of this paper is the first five hundred words; the rest is just helping it gain weight."
Harder mode: "When I'm short on words, even 'in conclusion' gets stretched into three paragraphs."

items.sourceNote: 教授課堂提問全班沉默 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
教授問「有沒有人要回答」的那三秒，
是全班默契最好的時刻——沒有人動，沒有人出聲，連呼吸都放輕了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 課堂被點問、全班集體低頭裝忙時發文，怕被教授掃到眼神的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「教授的視線掃過來時，整排同學低頭的速度快得像練過。」
進階版：「這題我其實知道答案，但我更知道『不要當那個舉手的人』。」

en.content:
The three seconds after the professor asks "anyone want to answer?"
are the most in-sync the whole class ever gets — nobody moves, nobody speaks, everyone even breathes quieter.
en.editorNote: Post it when the prof throws out a question and the whole class suddenly looks busy — anyone dodging eye contact gets it.
variations: Swap in: "When the professor's gaze sweeps the room, the entire row drops their heads like it's been rehearsed."
Harder mode: "I actually know the answer to this one, but I know even better not to be the person who raises a hand."

items.sourceNote: 'drinking coffee to stay awake to do nothing' 咖啡續命卻耍廢梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我熬夜灌了三杯咖啡讓自己保持清醒，
然後很清醒地、精神飽滿地，滑了一整晚的手機。
zh-tw.editorNote: 喝咖啡本來要拚報告、結果清醒地耍廢時發文，把咖啡浪費掉的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「咖啡確實有效，我現在非常清醒地知道，我什麼都沒做。」
進階版：「我不是靠咖啡讀書，我是靠咖啡撐著繼續耍廢。」

en.content:
I downed three cups of coffee to stay awake,
and then, wide awake and fully energized, I scrolled my phone all night long.
en.editorNote: Post it when the coffee meant for studying just fuels a night of doing nothing — anyone who's wasted their caffeine gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The coffee definitely worked — I'm now very alert to the fact that I got nothing done."
Harder mode: "I don't run on coffee to study, I run on coffee to keep slacking off."

items.sourceNote: 'owe my diploma to coffee, Google, and someone's notes' 靠估狗跟同學筆記畢業梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
如果我真的順利畢業，
那張證書有一半要歸功於咖啡、Google，還有考前一晚借我筆記的那位好心同學。
zh-tw.editorNote: 靠臨時抱佛腳跟同學筆記硬撐過來時發文，感謝過救命恩人的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的實力普通，但我認識厲害同學的能力，已經滿等了。」
進階版：「借我筆記的那位同學，才是我這學期真正的教授。」

en.content:
If I actually make it to graduation,
half of that diploma belongs to coffee, Google, and the kind classmate who lent me their notes the night before the exam.
en.editorNote: Post it when you scraped through on last-minute cramming and borrowed notes — anyone who's thanked a lifesaver gets it.
variations: Swap in: "My actual skills are average, but my skill at knowing smart classmates is fully maxed out."
Harder mode: "The classmate who lent me their notes was my real professor this semester."

items.sourceNote: 報告 deadline 延後全班歡呼 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
教授說「這份報告 deadline 延後一週」的那一刻，
全班的歡呼聲，比放榜還要熱烈——雖然我知道我還是會拖到最後一天。
zh-tw.editorNote: deadline 意外延後、全班瞬間活過來時發文，明知延後也照樣拖的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「延後一週的意思，是我可以多耍廢六天，最後一天再一次爆肝。」
進階版：「deadline 延後帶來的快樂，通常在第二天就被我還給宇宙了。」

en.content:
The moment the professor says "the deadline for this report is pushed back a week,"
the class cheers louder than on results day — even though I know I'll still leave it to the last day.
en.editorNote: Post it when a deadline unexpectedly moves and the whole class comes back to life — anyone who procrastinates anyway gets it.
variations: Swap in: "Pushed back a week means six more days to slack off and one more all-nighter at the end."
Harder mode: "The joy of a deadline extension usually gets returned to the universe by day two."

items.sourceNote: 'walking contradiction with highlighters' 螢光筆假認真梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
每學期開學我都會買一整組新的螢光筆，
彷彿只要顏色分得夠細，我就會突然變成一個會念書的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學狂買文具、買完卻沒在用時發文，同樣靠買文具找動力的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的筆記本永遠停在第一頁，但那一頁真的畫得很漂亮。」
進階版：「文具越買越齊，書卻越翻越少，這大概就是一種平衡。」

en.content:
Every semester I buy a whole new set of highlighters,
as if color-coding hard enough will magically turn me into someone who studies.
en.editorNote: For the stationery addict who buys it all and never uses it — fellow "buy-my-way-to-motivation" students get it.
variations: Swap in: "My notebook is permanently stuck on page one, but that page is genuinely beautiful."
Harder mode: "The more stationery I buy, the fewer pages I read — I guess that's a kind of balance."

items.sourceNote: 上台報告被提問腦袋空白 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
上台報告最恐怖的不是講稿背不熟，
是講完之後老師那句「有沒有人要提問」，以及底下真的有人舉手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 輪到自己上台、最怕 Q&A 環節時發文，報告全靠念稿的同學都懂那個瞬間。
variations: 也能換成：「報告我可以照稿念，但被問問題的那一秒，我的腦袋直接藍白當機。」
進階版：「拜託不要問我問題，我連自己剛剛在講什麼都是照稿念的。」

en.content:
The scariest part of a class presentation isn't forgetting your script,
it's the professor asking "any questions?" afterward — and someone actually raising their hand.
en.editorNote: For when it's your turn to present and you dread the Q&A — anyone who reads straight off the slides feels this.
variations: Swap in: "I can read my presentation off the script, but the second I get a question, my brain blue-screens."
Harder mode: "Please don't ask me anything — even I was just reading off the slides."

items.sourceNote: 'my backpack weighs more than my soul' 書包重量梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我的書包一天比一天重，
重到我開始懷疑裡面裝的不是課本，是我這學期還沒解決的所有煩惱。
zh-tw.editorNote: 每天背著一整包卻沒幾本真的在用時發文，通勤背重書包的學生都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「書包裡有八本課本，一整學期我只翻開過裝便當的那一格。」
進階版：「背書包上學這件事，唯一有在鍛鍊的是我的肩膀，不是我的腦袋。」

en.content:
My backpack gets heavier every day,
heavy enough that I'm starting to suspect it's not textbooks in there but every unsolved worry from this whole semester.
en.editorNote: Post it when you lug a full bag around daily but barely use anything in it — commuting students with heavy packs get it.
variations: Swap in: "Eight textbooks in my bag, and all semester the only compartment I've opened is the one with my lunch."
Harder mode: "The only thing carrying this backpack trains is my shoulders, definitely not my brain."

items.sourceNote: 'confidence Kanye, knowledge potato' 考試自信落差梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
走進考場前我信心爆棚，覺得自己天下無敵，
翻開考卷的那一秒，那份自信默默收拾行李，頭也不回地離開了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前莫名有自信、開考瞬間破功時發文，靠氣勢進考場的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的自信跟我的實力，從來不在同一個考場。」
進階版：「進場時我是學霸，作答時我是路人，交卷時我是哲學家——開始思考人生。」

en.content:
Before I walk into the exam I'm brimming with confidence, absolutely unstoppable;
the second I open the paper, that confidence quietly packs its bags and leaves without looking back.
en.editorNote: Post it when you feel weirdly confident before an exam and it collapses the instant it starts — the walk-in-on-vibes crowd gets it.
variations: Swap in: "My confidence and my actual ability have never once shown up to the same exam."
Harder mode: "Walking in I'm a top student, answering I'm a random stranger, submitting I'm a philosopher questioning my life choices."

items.sourceNote: 'I love deadlines, the whooshing sound they make as they fly by' deadline 咻一聲飛過梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我其實很喜歡 deadline，
特別是它「咻」一聲從我眼前飛過去，而我完全沒打算追上的那個瞬間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 眼睜睜看著繳交期限過去卻依然無動於衷時發文，重度拖延的同學會苦笑認領。
variations: 也能換成：「deadline 對我來說不是終點線，是我在旁邊揮手目送的風景。」
進階版：「我跟 deadline 的關係很和平，它從不逼我，我也從不理它。」

en.content:
Honestly, I love a good deadline —
especially the "whoosh" as it flies right past me, with me having zero intention of chasing after it.
en.editorNote: Post it when you watch a due date sail by and feel nothing — chronic procrastinators will claim it with a bitter smile.
variations: Swap in: "A deadline isn't a finish line to me, it's scenery I wave at from the sidelines."
Harder mode: "My relationship with deadlines is very peaceful — it never pressures me, and I never acknowledge it."

items.sourceNote: 'black belt in procrastination, not exams' 拖延黑帶梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
如果拖延也算一項技能，
我早就拿到黑帶了，只可惜考試從來不考這個。
zh-tw.editorNote: 自嘲一身「才華」全點在拖延上時發文，同溫層會回「這證照我也有」。
variations: 也能換成：「我最專精的科目是拖延學，可惜學校沒開這門課。」
進階版：「別人努力考證照，我努力練成不到最後一刻絕不動手的絕世神功。」

en.content:
If procrastination counted as a skill,
I'd have earned my black belt years ago — shame it never shows up on any exam.
en.editorNote: Self-deprecating post for when all your 'talent' is invested in stalling — the group will reply 'I'm certified in this too'.
variations: Swap in: "My best subject is Advanced Procrastination, pity the school never offers the class."
Harder mode: "Others grind for certifications; I've mastered the ancient art of not lifting a finger until the last second."

items.sourceNote: 'fluent in overthinking during exams' 考試腦內小劇場梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
考卷上一題不會的選擇題，
我可以在腦內幫四個選項各自編出一整套背景故事，就是選不出正確答案。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考試時越想越複雜、把簡單題想成申論題時發文，容易腦補的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是不會，我是想太多，把 A 想成 B、B 想成陷阱、最後選了 C。」
進階版：「這題老師說很直覺，我的直覺卻帶我繞了地球一圈才回到原點。」

en.content:
Give me one multiple-choice question I don't know,
and I'll invent a full backstory for all four options — I just can't pick the right one.
en.editorNote: Post it when you overthink a simple exam question into an essay — fellow spiral-thinkers get it.
variations: Swap in: "It's not that I don't know it — I overthought A into B, B into a trap, and ended up circling C."
Harder mode: "The prof said this one's intuitive; my intuition took me around the globe and back to where I started."

items.sourceNote: 考前群組互相取暖「你讀完了嗎」共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
考前群組裡最溫暖的一句話是「你們讀到哪了」，
因為大家的答案都是「還沒開始」，瞬間覺得自己不孤單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前群組互相確認進度、發現大家都沒讀時發文，同班一起擺爛的都懂那份安心。
variations: 也能換成：「原來全班都沒讀，這叫做同舟共濟，我踏實多了。」
進階版：「考前問『大家準備得如何』，其實是想確認沒有人偷偷變強。」

en.content:
The warmest thing in the group chat before an exam is "how far has everyone gotten?"
because everyone answers "haven't started" — and suddenly you don't feel so alone.
en.editorNote: Post it when the pre-exam chat reveals nobody studied — classmates slacking together know that exact relief.
variations: Swap in: "Turns out the whole class hasn't studied either — misery loves company, and I feel so much better."
Harder mode: "Asking 'how's everyone's prep going?' is really just checking nobody secretly got ahead."

items.sourceNote: 考前靠同學一份筆記撐全班 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
每個班上都有一個負責抄筆記的同學，
而全班的期末成績，基本上就掛在他那份筆記，跟一台影印機上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前狂傳同學筆記、全班共用一份救命講義時發文，靠別人筆記活過來的都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我這學期最感謝的不是教授，是那位願意分享筆記的活菩薩。」
進階版：「筆記傳到我手上已經是第十七手，畫重點的螢光筆都糊成一團了。」

en.content:
Every class has that one person who actually takes notes,
and the whole class's final grade basically hangs on their notes and a photocopier.
en.editorNote: Post it when everyone's frantically sharing one classmate's notes before the exam — anyone kept alive by borrowed notes gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The person I'm most grateful for this semester isn't the professor — it's the saint who shared their notes."
Harder mode: "By the time the notes reach me they're seventeenth-hand and the highlighter marks have all bled together."

items.sourceNote: 'Finals: the moment when all of your knowledge magically disappears' 考試腦袋空白梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我走進考場的時候，範圍明明全都會，
翻開考卷的那一秒，腦袋像被按了重置鍵，一片空白。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前明明有讀、進考場卻全忘光時發文，臨場失憶的同學都懂那種絕望。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是沒讀，我只是把知識存在一個連我自己都找不到的資料夾。」
進階版：「考卷發下來的瞬間，我這學期學的東西集體離職了。」

en.content:
Walking into the exam room, I genuinely knew the entire syllabus.
The second I opened the paper, my brain hit reset and went completely blank.
en.editorNote: Post it when you studied but blanked the moment the exam started — anyone who's gone blank on the spot knows that despair.
variations: Swap in: "It's not that I didn't study, I just saved the knowledge in a folder even I can't find."
Harder mode: "The instant the paper landed on my desk, everything I learned this semester collectively resigned."

items.sourceNote: 'I owe my diploma to coffee, Google, and good notes' 報告靠 Google 依賴梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
老師問我這份報告的參考資料是什麼，
我很誠實：搜尋結果的第一頁，還有一個叫『我猜的』的權威來源。
zh-tw.editorNote: 報告全靠 Google 前幾筆湊出來時發文，臨時拼報告的同學會心虛地笑。
variations: 也能換成：「我的文獻回顧，回顧的是搜尋引擎的前三個連結。」
進階版：「報告寫得頭頭是道，其實九成內容我自己也是剛剛才第一次看到。」

en.content:
My professor asked what sources I used for this report.
I was honest: page one of the search results, and a trusted authority named "I'm pretty sure."
en.editorNote: Post it when your whole report is cobbled together from the top search hits — last-minute writers will laugh guiltily.
variations: Swap in: "My literature review reviews the first three links on the search engine."
Harder mode: "My report sounds authoritative, but ninety percent of it I was reading for the first time too."

items.sourceNote: 'all of your knowledge magically disappears' 考完立刻忘光梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
交卷的那一秒，我腦袋裡的知識就像退潮一樣，
瞬間退得乾乾淨淨，一滴都不留給我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完立刻把念的全忘光時發文，考完就清空記憶體的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的記憶體只租到交卷為止，時間一到自動格式化。」
進階版：「別問我剛剛考什麼，我跟那些內容的緣分已經隨著鐘聲結束了。」

en.content:
The second I hand in the exam, the knowledge in my head rolls out like the tide —
instantly, completely, without leaving me a single drop.
en.editorNote: Post it when everything you memorized evaporates the moment the exam ends — anyone who wipes their RAM at the bell gets it.
variations: Swap in: "My memory is only rented until I hand in the paper — time's up, auto-formatted."
Harder mode: "Don't ask what was on the exam; my bond with that material ended with the bell."

items.sourceNote: 'How are you? Finals. That's it, that's the tweet' 一句話人生梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
朋友問我最近過得如何，
我只回了兩個字：期末。
這兩個字，已經完整概括了我整個人生。
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末週生活只剩考試、連句子都懶得打時發文，被期末吞沒的同學秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的近況更新只有一個狀態：期末進行中，請勿打擾。」
進階版：「這陣子我沒有生活，我只有一份永遠寫不完的待辦清單。」

en.content:
A friend asked how I've been lately.
I replied with one word: finals.
That one word sums up my entire existence right now.
en.editorNote: Post it during finals when your whole life is exams and you can't even manage a full sentence — anyone swallowed by finals gets it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "My only status update is one status: finals in progress, do not disturb."
Harder mode: "I don't have a life these days, I have a to-do list that never ends."

items.sourceNote: 自由分組社交恐慌 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
老師說「這次報告自由分組」，
那一刻教室裡的氣氛，比任何一場考試都還要緊張。
zh-tw.editorNote: 老師宣布自由分組、全班瞬間開始眼神交流找隊友時發文，怕落單的同學都懂那份社交恐慌。
variations: 也能換成：「自由分組四個字，是社恐學生一學期最大的難關。」
進階版：「別人早就約好一組，我還在盤算等等要厚著臉皮問誰。」

en.content:
The professor said, "You can form your own groups for this one."
In that moment the tension in the room beat any exam I've ever sat.
en.editorNote: Post it when the prof announces free grouping and the whole class starts frantic eye contact hunting for teammates — anyone scared of being left over knows that social panic.
variations: Swap in: "'Form your own groups' is the single hardest challenge of the semester for a socially anxious student."
Harder mode: "Everyone else paired up ages ago, and I'm still figuring out who I'll awkwardly ask."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 心情板 大學生暑假作息 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
放暑假才第二個禮拜，
我的作息已經跟地球另一邊的人完全同步了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假日夜顛倒、天亮才睡時發文，同樣睡到下午的朋友會秒認領。
variations: 也能換成：「我沒有熬夜，我只是提早開始過明天。」
進階版：「暑假唯一準時的事，就是我每天都在日出的時候上床。」

en.content:
It's only week two of summer break
and my sleep schedule is fully synced with people on the other side of the planet.
en.editorNote: For summer nights flipped upside down — friends who also wake up at 3 p.m. will claim it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not staying up late, I'm just getting an early start on tomorrow."
Harder mode: "The only punctual thing about my summer is that I go to bed at sunrise every day."

items.sourceNote: 大學生焦慮暑假空白、羨慕同儕 新聞共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
同學的暑假是實習、交換、環島，
我的暑假是滑他們的限動，然後躺回原本的位置。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假被同儕動態刺激到、覺得自己一事無成時發文，同溫層會回「一起躺」。
variations: 也能換成：「治好暑假焦慮最快的方法，是把社群軟體刪掉三天。」
進階版：「我的暑假很充實，充實的是手機的螢幕使用時間報告。」

en.content:
My classmates' summer is internships, exchange programs, and road trips.
My summer is scrolling their stories and then lying back down exactly where I was.
en.editorNote: Post it when everyone else's feed makes your break feel empty — your people will reply "lying down with you."
variations: Swap in: "The fastest cure for summer anxiety is deleting social media for three days."
Harder mode: "My summer has been very productive — mostly according to my screen time report."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 大學生活 暑修 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
全世界都在放暑假，
只有我在冷氣壞掉的教室裡，用暑修證明我上學期有多不認真。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被當去暑修的同學專用，配一張空蕩教室的照片更有畫面。
variations: 也能換成：「暑修的學費，是我為去年那個不想去上課的自己付的贖金。」
進階版：「別人的暑假在倒數開學，我的暑假在倒數補考。」

en.content:
The whole world is on summer break,
and I'm in a classroom with broken AC, proving through summer school how little I tried last semester.
en.editorNote: For anyone retaking a failed course over the break — pair it with a photo of an empty lecture hall.
variations: Swap in: "Summer school tuition is the ransom I'm paying for last year's version of me who wouldn't go to class."
Harder mode: "Other people are counting down to the new semester; I'm counting down to a retake exam."

items.sourceNote: 大學生暑期打工實習 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
我整個暑假都在排班，
然後在開學前三天，把賺到的錢一次繳給了學費。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假打工賺錢卻直接進學費的無力感，半工半讀的同學一看就懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的暑假打工薪水，在戶頭停留的時間比我放假的時間還短。」
進階版：「別人暑假回來曬黑是去海邊，我是去外送。」

en.content:
I worked shifts all summer,
then three days before school started I handed the whole paycheck over to tuition.
en.editorNote: The quiet despair of a summer job that goes straight to fees — working students get it immediately.
variations: Swap in: "My summer paycheck stayed in my account for less time than my actual vacation lasted."
Harder mode: "Other people come back tan from the beach; I came back tan from delivering food."

items.sourceNote: 暑假計畫清單 vs 現實 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
放假第一天我列了一張暑假清單：考證照、運動、看十本書。
現在清單還在，只是被壓在吃完的零食袋下面。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假過一半、清單一項都沒動時發文，立志派同學會苦笑。
variations: 也能換成：「我的暑假計畫執行率，跟我的起床時間成反比。」
進階版：「暑假還有一半的時候，我就已經在心裡把它結案了。」

en.content:
Day one of break I wrote a summer list: get certified, work out, read ten books.
The list still exists — it's just buried under an empty snack bag.
en.editorNote: Post it halfway through summer when you haven't touched a single item; the ambitious crowd will laugh through the pain.
variations: Swap in: "My summer plan completion rate is inversely proportional to what time I wake up."
Harder mode: "Summer was only half over and I'd already mentally closed the case on it."

items.sourceNote: 大學生靠學長姐考古題續命 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
考前我最大的信仰不是課本，
是學長姐留下來的考古題——有考古題我就安心睡覺，沒考古題我才會認真祈禱。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前瘋狂翻考古題、有題目就當有讀書時發文，靠考古題續命的同學秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「這科我沒讀，但我把三年的考古題都背起來了，這也算一種認真吧。」
進階版：「考古題重複的那一刻，我對這位出題老師的愛已經滿出來了。」

en.content:
Before an exam my real faith isn't in the textbook,
it's in the past papers the seniors left behind — with them I sleep soundly, without them is when I actually start praying.
en.editorNote: For the frantic pre-exam hunt through old exams — anyone who survives on past papers gets it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "I didn't study this subject, but I memorized three years of past papers — that counts as effort, right?"
Harder mode: "The second a past-paper question shows up again, my love for that professor completely overflows."

items.sourceNote: 'crashes right after I forgot to save' 檔案沒存全消失梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
我熬了一整夜把報告寫到快完成，
然後電腦一聲不響地當掉，連句「你沒存檔喔」的提醒都懶得給我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 辛苦打的字沒存檔全部消失、欲哭無淚時發文，被電腦背刺過的都懂那種心碎。
variations: 也能換成：「我不怕改到第八版，我怕的是改完那一秒，檔案跟我的努力一起蒸發。」
進階版：「自動存檔是這世界上最溫柔的功能，可惜我每次都是關掉它之後才想起它。」

en.content:
I stayed up all night getting the report almost done,
and then my computer crashed without a sound — too lazy to even warn me I hadn't saved.
en.editorNote: For when hours of typing vanish unsaved and you're too devastated to cry — anyone stabbed in the back by their laptop knows the heartbreak.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not scared of reaching draft eight, I'm scared of the file evaporating along with all my effort the second I finish."
Harder mode: "Autosave is the gentlest feature in the world — shame I only remember it exists right after I turn it off."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 大學生 教授拖堂 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
下課鐘聲響的那一刻，教授說：「這個很快，再五分鐘就好。」
那五分鐘，是我這輩子經歷過最漫長的五分鐘。
zh-tw.editorNote: 教授拖堂、全班眼神死盯著時鐘時發文，被拖到趕不上下一節或公車的都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「教授的『再五分鐘』和我媽的『馬上到』，是全世界最不可信的兩個時間單位。」
進階版：「拖堂十分鐘，我損失的不只是下課，是我趕下一班公車的所有希望。」

en.content:
The second the bell rings, the professor says, "This'll be quick, just five more minutes."
Those five minutes were the longest five minutes of my entire life.
en.editorNote: For when the prof runs over and the whole class stares daggers at the clock — anyone who's missed a bus or the next class to it gets it.
variations: Swap in: "A professor's 'five more minutes' and my mom's 'I'm almost there' are the two least trustworthy units of time on earth."
Harder mode: "Ten minutes of overtime cost me more than my break — it cost me every hope of catching the next bus."

items.sourceNote: 搶不到課現場跪求加簽 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
想修的課全部額滿，我只好厚著臉皮站在教室門口等加簽，
那一刻我才發現，原來我的自尊，可以為了兩學分彎得這麼低。
zh-tw.editorNote: 搶不到課只能到現場跪求加簽時發文，加簽單被拒或苦等的同學最有感。
variations: 也能換成：「為了一張加簽單，我可以對著不熟的教授露出這輩子最真誠的笑容。」
進階版：「別人搶課靠手速，我搶課靠的是站在門口一整節的意志力。」

en.content:
Every class I wanted was full, so I swallowed my pride and stood at the door begging for an add-slip,
and that's when I learned exactly how low my dignity will bend for two measly credits.
en.editorNote: For when you're shut out of a class and have to beg in person for a signature — anyone refused or left waiting gets it.
variations: Swap in: "For a single add-slip, I can flash a professor I barely know the most sincere smile of my life."
Harder mode: "Other people grab classes with typing speed; I grab them by standing at the door through an entire period on sheer willpower."

items.sourceNote: 'computers crash while pretending to help' 繳交系統死線當掉梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
死線是晚上十一點五十九分，
我十一點五十七分按下上傳，然後繳交系統選在這一刻，優雅地當掉給我看。
zh-tw.editorNote: 壓線交作業結果系統崩潰、螢幕轉圈圈時發文，被線上系統背刺過的都懂那種絕望。
variations: 也能換成：「不是我拖到最後一刻，是系統偏偏挑最後一刻罷工。」
進階版：「上傳進度條卡在百分之九十九的那幾秒，是我一整個學期心跳最快的時候。」

en.content:
The deadline is 11:59 p.m.
I hit upload at 11:57, and that's the exact moment the submission system chose to elegantly crash on me.
en.editorNote: For when you cut it close and the portal melts down with the spinner still turning — anyone stabbed in the back by an online system knows the despair.
variations: Swap in: "It's not that I left it to the last second, it's that the system picked the last second to go on strike."
Harder mode: "Those few seconds with the upload bar frozen at ninety-nine percent were the fastest my heart raced all semester."

items.sourceNote: 學生用 ChatGPT 寫作業、怕被抓包 潤稿去 AI 味 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
現在寫報告最緊張的一刻，不是按下繳交的那一秒，
而是把 AI 生出來的內容重讀一遍，努力把它改得不像 AI 寫的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 用 AI 幫忙寫作業卻怕被抓包時發文，同屆同學都懂那種潤稿潤到懷疑人生的心情。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是不會寫，我只是負責把 AI 的文謅謅翻譯成人話。」
進階版：「AI 十分鐘寫完，我花兩小時把它改得像我半夜硬擠出來的。」

en.content:
The most nerve-wracking part of writing a paper now isn't hitting submit —
it's rereading what the AI generated and frantically editing it so it doesn't read like AI wrote it.
en.editorNote: Post it when you leaned on AI for an assignment and now dread getting caught — everyone in your year knows the 'editing until you question your life' feeling.
variations: Swap in: "It's not that I can't write, I just handle translating the AI's fancy essay into human."
Harder mode: "AI finished it in ten minutes; I spent two hours making it look like I scraped it together at 3 a.m."

items.sourceNote: 上台報告排練百遍、一站上去全忘光 緊張發抖 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
輪到我上台報告的前一秒，我把講稿背得滾瓜爛熟；
站上台的那一秒，我連自己叫什麼名字都需要看一下學生證。
zh-tw.editorNote: 上台簡報前排練百遍、一站上去卻全忘光時發文，會上台發抖的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「報告時我的手在抖、聲音在飄，只有簡報翻頁鍵按得很堅定。」
進階版：「台下練得像 TED，台上講得像人質影片。」

en.content:
One second before it's my turn to present, I've got my script memorized cold;
the second I'm standing up there, I need to check my student ID to remember my own name.
en.editorNote: Post it when you rehearse a hundred times and blank the instant you stand up — anyone who shakes on stage gets it.
variations: Swap in: "During my presentation my hands shake and my voice wobbles — only my thumb on the clicker stays confident."
Harder mode: "Backstage I rehearse like a TED talk; on stage I deliver like a hostage video."

items.sourceNote: 教授愛拖堂、下課鐘響繼續講 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
下課鐘響的那一刻，教授說「這個概念很重要，我再講五分鐘」，
二十分鐘後，我的午餐、我的下一堂課，還有我的求生意志，都已經先走了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 遇到愛拖堂的老師、看著時鐘一分一秒過去時發文，被拖堂餓過肚子的都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「教授的『再五分鐘』和店家的『馬上到』，是這世界上最不可信的兩句話。」
進階版：「下課鐘對我是解脫，對教授只是背景音。」

en.content:
The second the bell rings, the professor says "this concept is important, just five more minutes,"
and twenty minutes later my lunch, my next class, and my will to live have all already left without me.
en.editorNote: Post it when you're stuck with a professor who runs overtime and watch the clock tick — anyone who's gone hungry from an overrun class gets it.
variations: Swap in: "A professor's 'just five more minutes' and a delivery guy's 'almost there' are the two least trustworthy phrases on earth."
Harder mode: "The bell means freedom to me and background noise to the professor."

items.sourceNote: 大一原文書看不懂 每個單字都查得到卻讀不懂整段 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
原文書我每個單字都查得出來，
但整句連起來，我還是不知道它到底想告訴我什麼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 翻開厚厚一本原文課本、每個字都認識卻看不懂整段時發文，讀原文書讀到懷疑人生的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「原文書最貴的不是價錢，是我為了看懂它花掉的青春。」
進階版：「我不是英文不好，我是連中文翻譯版都需要再翻譯一次。」

en.content:
I can look up every single word in the textbook,
but string the sentence together and I still have no idea what it's trying to tell me.
en.editorNote: Post it when you crack open a thick English-language textbook and know every word yet understand nothing — anyone reading course texts in a second language gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The most expensive thing about this textbook isn't the price, it's the youth I spent trying to understand it."
Harder mode: "It's not that my English is bad, it's that even the translated version needs translating."

items.sourceNote: 英文畢業門檻 英檢差幾分不能畢業 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
我以為大學最難的是專業科目，
畢業前才發現，真正擋住我的是那張永遠差幾分的英檢成績單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被英文畢業門檻卡住、重考英檢好幾次時發文，差幾分不能畢業的同學最有感。
variations: 也能換成：「我的畢業證書，現在被一張多益成績單扣在門外。」
進階版：「四年專業學得再好，最後決定我能不能畢業的，是一場跟本科無關的英文考試。」

en.content:
I thought the hardest part of college would be my major courses;
right before graduation I realized the real thing blocking me is that English test score I keep missing by a few points.
en.editorNote: Post it when the English graduation requirement traps you and you're retaking the test for the third time — anyone a few points short of graduating feels this.
variations: Swap in: "My diploma is currently being held hostage outside the door by one language test score."
Harder mode: "Four years of mastering my major, and whether I graduate comes down to an English exam that has nothing to do with it."

items.sourceNote: 課表中間空堂本想讀書結果耍廢 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
課表中間空了三小時，我一開始的計畫是去圖書館讀書，
實際上我在便利商店的座位區，把這三小時活成了一場小型午睡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 課跟課之間卡了尷尬的空堂、本想讀書結果耍廢時發文，課表被拆得零零落落的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「空堂三小時，讀書零分鐘，發呆滿分。」
進階版：「別人的空堂拿來預習，我的空堂拿來研究學餐哪一攤還沒吃過。」

en.content:
There's a three-hour gap between my two classes today.
The plan was to study at the library; in reality I turned it into a mini-nap in the seating area of a convenience store.
en.editorNote: Post it when an awkward gap between classes meant for studying turns into slacking off — anyone with a schedule chopped full of holes gets it.
variations: Swap in: "Three-hour gap, zero minutes of studying, full marks for spacing out."
Harder mode: "Other people use their free period to prep; I use mine to research which dining-hall stall I haven't tried yet."

items.sourceNote: 'dark circles that never go away once you get them in college' 熬夜黑眼圈變常駐梗改寫

zh-tw.content:
上大學之前我還會被說看起來很有精神，
現在同學看到我的第一句話是：你這黑眼圈，是天生的還是這學期練出來的？
zh-tw.editorNote: 熬夜熬到氣色崩壞、黑眼圈變常駐時發文，臉上寫滿疲憊的大學生都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的黑眼圈已經深到，可以直接當我的第二個學位。」
進階版：「大學沒教會我什麼專業，倒是把我從一個少年，練成一個需要遮瑕膏的人。」

en.content:
Before college, people used to say I looked bright-eyed;
now the first thing classmates say when they see me is: those dark circles — were you born with them, or did this semester earn them for you?
en.editorNote: Post it when late nights have wrecked your complexion and the eye bags became permanent — every worn-down student gets it.
variations: Swap in: "My dark circles are so deep by now they basically count as my second degree."
Harder mode: "College didn't teach me a profession, but it did turn me from a fresh-faced kid into someone who needs concealer."

items.sourceNote: 2026（115 學年度）暑假與開學日期行事曆；暑假日記開學前一次補完的台灣在地共感原創

zh-tw.content:
暑假日記我一天都沒寫，
現在只好把一個月前的氣象紀錄叫出來，一天一天幫過去的自己回憶那天心情很好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假過一半才想起還有暑假作業、開始靠天氣紀錄補日記時發文，每個補過日記的人都懂那種心虛。
variations: 也能換成：「我的暑假日記寫得最認真的部分，是那三十天的天氣。」
進階版：「老師一眼看穿的不是我沒寫日記，是我整個七月的心情都一模一樣。」

en.content:
I haven't written a single entry in my summer journal,
so now I've got a month of old weather reports open, inventing a nice mood for my past self one day at a time.
en.editorNote: Post it when you remember the summer assignment halfway through the break and start backfilling a journal from weather archives — anyone who's faked a diary gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The most carefully researched part of my summer journal is thirty days of weather."
Harder mode: "What gives me away isn't the blank journal — it's that I was in the exact same mood for all of July."

items.sourceNote: 2026 暑假／開學日期行事曆報導；七月底暑假過半、開學倒數的焦慮感原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
七月初我還敢說暑假長到看不見盡頭，
結果日曆一翻到八月，那個盡頭就直接站在我面前跟我揮手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 七月底、暑假只剩一個月時發文，還沒開始執行任何暑假計畫的學生會瞬間被戳到。
variations: 也能換成：「暑假的前兩個月過得像兩天，最後一個月會過得像兩個禮拜。」
進階版：「我不是怕開學，我是怕開學問我這個暑假做了什麼。」

en.content:
At the start of July I was still saying summer break stretched on forever.
Then the calendar flipped to August, and forever showed up in person to wave at me.
en.editorNote: Post it in late July when only a month of break is left and none of your summer plans have started — instantly relatable to every student.
variations: Swap in: "The first two months of break go by like two days; the last month goes by like two weeks."
Harder mode: "I'm not scared of school starting. I'm scared of being asked what I did all summer."

items.sourceNote: 大學生暑期工讀生心得報導；早八爬不起來但打工早班準時的反差原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
早八的鬧鐘我可以連按五次，
打工早班的鬧鐘我第一聲就彈起來——原來我缺的從來不是意志力，是時薪。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假打工排早班、卻想起自己學期中早八全勤失敗時發文，半工半讀的同學笑著認領。
variations: 也能換成：「我對遲到扣薪的恐懼，遠遠大於我對被點名的恐懼。」
進階版：「學校要是願意用時薪算學分，我大概可以當到書卷獎。」

en.content:
I can snooze the alarm for my 8 a.m. class five times in a row,
but the alarm for my opening shift gets me upright on the first ring — turns out what I was missing was never willpower, it was an hourly wage.
en.editorNote: Post it during a summer job when the early shifts expose how badly you handled your morning classes — every working student will claim it.
variations: Swap in: "My fear of getting docked pay is way stronger than my fear of a roll call."
Harder mode: "If school paid by the hour, I'd be an honor student by now."

items.sourceNote: 大學生暑假生活討論串；暑假在家開整天冷氣、電費帳單比成績單刺激的原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
整個七月我把冷氣當成空氣在開，
直到電費帳單寄到，我才發現這個夏天最讓我心跳加速的數字，不是我的成績。
