zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假在家耍廢、冷氣不敢關又怕帳單時發文，租屋族和月底吃土的學生特別有感。
variations: 也能換成：「我的暑假只有兩種溫度：冷氣房，和收到帳單之後的心涼。」
進階版：「爸媽問我暑假學到什麼，我說我學會了看電表。」

en.content:
All through July I ran the AC like it was oxygen,
until the electric bill arrived and I found out the scariest number of my summer wasn't my GPA.
en.editorNote: Post it when you're melting at home all break, afraid to turn the AC off and more afraid of the bill — renters and broke students feel this one.
variations: Swap in: "My summer has two temperatures: air-conditioned, and the chill after the bill lands."
Harder mode: "My parents asked what I learned this summer. I said I learned how to read the electric meter."

items.sourceNote: 學生暑假安排／自我進修相關報導；線上課程買了沒上完的共感原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
放假第一週我一口氣報名三堂線上課程，準備脫胎換骨；
現在七月底了，三堂課的進度整整齊齊停在「第一單元：課程介紹」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假立志自我提升、結果課程買了沒開時發文，收藏夾比進度條長的人都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是在學新技能，我是在收集新技能的購買紀錄。」
進階版：「我暑假最有紀律的一件事，就是每堂課都只看完免費試看的那一段。」

en.content:
Week one of break, I signed up for three online courses, ready to become a whole new person.
It's the end of July and all three are still parked, very neatly, on "Lesson 1: Course Introduction."
en.editorNote: Post it when the summer self-improvement plan turned into a receipts collection — anyone whose saved list is longer than their progress bar gets it.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not learning new skills, I'm collecting proof of purchase for new skills."
Harder mode: "The most disciplined thing I did all summer was watch the free preview of every single course."

items.sourceNote: college meme 期末算最低及格分數的共感梗原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
整個學期我算不出任何一題數學，
卻能在期末前精準算出「這科我還要拿幾分才會過」，誤差不超過零點五分。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前打開成績試算表、倒推最低及格分數時的真心話，把「戰略性放棄」演到極致的人都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我這學期唯一認真解的方程式，就是及格分數。」
進階版：「不用讀全部，只要讀到剛好會過的那條線就好——這叫資源分配。」

en.content:
I couldn't solve a single math problem all semester,
yet right before finals I can calculate the exact score I still need to pass this class, accurate to within half a point.
en.editorNote: The honest caption for anyone who opens a grade spreadsheet to reverse-engineer the minimum passing score — peak strategic giving-up.
variations: Swap in: "The only equation I actually solved this semester was my passing grade."
Harder mode: "I don't need to study all of it, just up to the line where I barely pass — I call that resource allocation."

items.sourceNote: Threads 大一vs大四心態迷因（被當重修→一學期20學分）原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
大一的我：被當一科而已，重修就好，有什麼大不了。
大四的我：翻著這學期二十三學分的課表，已經笑不出來了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被學分追著跑的高年級生看了會沉默點頭，適合搭配一張爆炸課表截圖。
variations: 也能換成：「當年隨手放掉的每一科，都在畢業那年排隊回來找我。」
進階版：「大一的我在存學分，大四的我在還學分，利息還特別重。」

en.content:
Freshman me: it's just one failed class, I'll retake it, no big deal.
Senior me: staring at a twenty-three-credit schedule this semester, not laughing anymore.
en.editorNote: Upperclassmen buried under credits will nod in silence — pair it with a screenshot of an overloaded timetable.
variations: Swap in: "Every class I casually dropped back then lined up to find me again in my final year."
Harder mode: "Freshman me was banking credits; senior me is repaying them, with brutal interest."

items.sourceNote: 生產式拖延（deadline前突然大掃除）meme 原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
報告死線前一晚，我突然對這個房間產生了強烈的責任感，
書桌整理好了、衣櫃分類好了、連抽屜深處的發票都收得整整齊齊，就是報告一個字沒動。
zh-tw.editorNote: 越接近死線房間越乾淨的「生產式拖延」代表作，發限動大家會默默認領同一種病。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是在逃避報告，我是在為寫報告打造一個完美的環境，打造了六個小時。」
進階版：「全世界最愛乾淨的人，就是那個明天要交報告的我。」

en.content:
The night before a paper is due, I suddenly develop a deep sense of responsibility toward this room:
desk organized, closet sorted, even the receipts in the back of the drawer neatly filed — and not one word of the paper written.
en.editorNote: The definitive 'productive procrastination' line — the closer the deadline, the cleaner the room. Post it and watch everyone quietly claim the same disease.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not avoiding the paper, I'm building the perfect environment to write it — six hours of building."
Harder mode: "The tidiest person on earth is me the night before a deadline."

items.sourceNote: 學期末二手課本賤價回收的共感梗原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
學期初我花一千二買了這本原文書，
學期末拿去二手回收，老闆看了一眼說：「三十塊，因為你有畫線。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 期末賣課本被殺到見骨時發文，體驗過知識貶值速度的人都懂那種心痛。
variations: 也能換成：「我的課本一翻開就折舊，一畢業就變廢紙，中間完全沒經過『有用』這一段。」
進階版：「課本買的時候是投資，賣的時候是做公益。」

en.content:
At the start of the semester I paid forty bucks for this textbook.
At the end I took it to the used-book buyer, who glanced at it and said: "One dollar — you highlighted in it."
en.editorNote: Post it when the end-of-semester buyback lowballs you to nothing — anyone who's felt knowledge depreciate in real time knows the ache.
variations: Swap in: "My textbook depreciates the second I open it and turns to scrap the day I graduate, skipping the 'useful' phase entirely."
Harder mode: "Buying the textbook is an investment; selling it back is charity."

items.sourceNote: college meme 系上活動社交耗盡（I 人充電）原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
系上每辦一次迎新、系烤、系遊，
我的社交電量就要花整整一個禮拜獨處才能充回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 系上活動一場接一場、社恐同學回宿舍就地當機時發文，需要充電的 I 人都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「別人參加系烤是聯絡感情，我參加系烤是消耗這學期剩下的社交額度。」
進階版：「報名的時候很興奮，出發前一小時只想傳訊息說我突然有事。」

en.content:
Every time my department throws a welcome party, a barbecue, or a class trip,
it takes me a full week of alone time to recharge my social battery.
en.editorNote: Post it when department events pile up and you crash the second you get back to your dorm — every introvert who needs to recharge gets it.
variations: Swap in: "Other people go to the class barbecue to bond; I go to burn through my remaining social quota for the semester."
Harder mode: "I'm thrilled when I sign up, then an hour before it starts I just want to text that something suddenly came up."

items.sourceNote: 在學校找插座搶插座的共感梗原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
在學校找到一個有插座的空位，
那種喜悅程度，大概只有中樂透可以比。
zh-tw.editorNote: 帶著快沒電的筆電在教室、圖書館到處找插座時發文，電量焦慮的同學秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「決定我坐哪裡的從來不是風景，是離插座有多近。」
進階版：「筆電剩百分之三，全校的插座卻集體跟我作對。」

en.content:
Finding an empty seat with a power outlet on campus
brings a joy roughly comparable to winning the lottery.
en.editorNote: Post it when you're roaming classrooms and the library with a dying laptop hunting for an outlet — battery-anxiety students get it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "What decides where I sit is never the view, it's how close the outlet is."
Harder mode: "Laptop at three percent and every outlet on campus decided to team up against me."

items.sourceNote: 翹課靠同學代點名喊有的友情梗原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
大學最深厚的友情，
是那個願意在點名時幫你喊一聲「有」的同學。
zh-tw.editorNote: 翹課靠朋友代點名、關係好到能互相喊有時發文，有過這種革命情感的都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「他幫我喊一聲『有』，我這學期的出席率就交給他了。」
進階版：「代喊點名這種事，只能託付給值得信任的人——還有聲音夠像的人。」

en.content:
The deepest friendship in college
is the classmate willing to shout "here!" for you during roll call.
en.editorNote: Post it when you skip class and a friend covers your attendance — anyone who's shared that bond of trust gets it.
variations: Swap in: "He shouts one 'here' for me, and my whole semester's attendance rate is in his hands."
Harder mode: "Answering roll call for someone can only be trusted to the right person — and one whose voice sounds enough like yours."

items.sourceNote: 學餐自助餐夾菜心理戰的共感梗原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
在學餐自助餐夾菜，我的手比考試還謹慎，
因為每夾一口，都在跟月底的錢包玩心理戰。
zh-tw.editorNote: 在學校自助餐前猶豫夾哪一道、深怕破百時發文，月底預算緊繃的同學最有感。
variations: 也能換成：「自助餐最貴的不是那塊肉，是我夾的時候那份猶豫。」
進階版：「夾菜的時候手抖，不是因為餓，是因為我在心裡默默加總。」

en.content:
Piling food onto my plate at the cafeteria buffet, my hand is steadier during an exam,
because every scoop is a mind game with my end-of-month wallet.
en.editorNote: Post it when you hesitate over which dish to grab at the cafeteria buffet, terrified of breaking the budget — students scraping by at month's end feel this.
variations: Swap in: "The priciest thing at the buffet isn't the meat, it's the hesitation while I serve myself."
Harder mode: "My hand shakes while I serve — not from hunger, but from silently adding up the total."

items.sourceNote: 必修被排在地獄時段的課表共感梗原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
系上把必修排在禮拜五下午最後一節，
擺明就是要考驗我對這個科系，到底還剩下多少愛。
zh-tw.editorNote: 必修被排在超廢時段、全班眼神死時發文，被課表整過的同學都懂那種絕望。
variations: 也能換成：「禮拜五下午的必修，出席的不是學生，是一群還在硬撐的靈魂。」
進階版：「排課的人一定跟我有仇，不然怎麼把我最不想上的課，塞在最不想上課的時間。」

en.content:
My department scheduled a required course for the very last slot on Friday afternoon,
clearly to test exactly how much love I have left for this major.
en.editorNote: Post it when a required class lands in the worst possible time slot and the whole room looks dead inside — anyone wrecked by their timetable knows the despair.
variations: Swap in: "A Friday-afternoon required course isn't attended by students, but by a room of souls still forcing themselves to hang on."
Harder mode: "Whoever built this schedule must have a grudge against me — why else cram my least favorite class into the time I least want to be in class?"

items.sourceNote: 隨堂突襲小考 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
教授笑著說「我們來個小測驗」的那一刻，
整間教室的空氣，瞬間比冷氣還冷。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被突襲隨堂考殺得措手不及時發文，翹過那堂的同學會邊笑邊發抖。
variations: 也能換成：「隨堂考最可怕的地方，是它專挑我剛好翹掉那堂的進度考。」
進階版：「老師發下考卷那一秒，我認真思考的不是答案，是我為什麼會來上課。」

en.content:
The second the professor smiles and says "let's have a quick quiz,"
the air in the whole room turns colder than the AC.
en.editorNote: Post it when a surprise pop quiz catches you off guard — anyone who skipped that exact lecture will laugh and shiver at once.
variations: Swap in: "The scariest thing about a pop quiz is that it always covers the one lecture I skipped."
Harder mode: "The moment the quiz lands on my desk, I'm not thinking about the answers — I'm wondering why I even came to class."

items.sourceNote: 缺課上限被扣考 register 改寫

zh-tw.content:
這學期我最認真計算的一門課，
不是它的學分，是我還剩幾次可以翹、翹到第幾次會被扣考。
zh-tw.editorNote: 把缺課次數當額度精算的翹課常客最有感，接近上限時發文一票人默默對號入座。
variations: 也能換成：「別人在算 GPA，我在算我的翹課額度還夠不夠撐到期末。」
進階版：「我對這堂課唯一的敬畏，是那條『缺課三次就扣考』的紅線。」

en.content:
The thing I calculate most carefully this semester
isn't the course's credits — it's how many more times I can skip before I get barred from the final.
en.editorNote: Hits hardest for the regular skipper who treats absences like a budget — post it near the limit and a whole crowd will quietly relate.
variations: Swap in: "Other people are calculating their GPA; I'm calculating whether my skip budget lasts till finals."
Harder mode: "The only thing I respect about this class is the red line that says 'three absences and you're barred from the exam.'"

items.sourceNote: 圖書館借書逾期罰款 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
我從圖書館借了一本書，打算好好充實自己，
三個月後它教會我的唯一一件事，是逾期一天要罰多少錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 借了書沒讀、逾期繳罰款時發文，總是把還書日拖到最後的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「這本書我一頁沒翻，卻靠它繳的罰款，順利贊助了圖書館的營運。」
進階版：「我跟這本書的關係很純粹：它躺在我書桌，我付它的租金。」

en.content:
I borrowed a book from the library, fully planning to better myself,
and three months later the only thing it taught me was the daily overdue fine.
en.editorNote: Post it when you never opened the book and paid the late fee instead — anyone who drags the return date to the bitter end knows this.
variations: Swap in: "I never turned a single page, but the fine I paid on it generously funded the library's operations."
Harder mode: "My relationship with this book is pure: it lies on my desk, and I pay its rent."

items.sourceNote: 畢業專題進度焦慮 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
指導老師問我畢業專題的進度，
我很有自信地回答：題目已經想到第七個版本了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 專題卡在改題目、遲遲沒動工時發文，跑過 meeting 被電的同組戰友都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我的專題目前最完整的部分，是封面跟組員名單。」
進階版：「別人的專題已經在跑實驗，我的專題還在跟我談要不要開始。」

en.content:
My advisor asked how my capstone project is coming along,
and I confidently replied: I've already brainstormed the topic to its seventh version.
en.editorNote: Post it when your project is stuck on rewording the title with zero real progress — teammates who got grilled in the same meeting will feel it.
variations: Swap in: "The most complete part of my project so far is the cover page and the list of group members."
Harder mode: "Other people's projects are already running experiments; mine is still negotiating with me about whether to begin."

items.sourceNote: 考完對答案崩潰 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
考完試最刺激的環節，不是考試本身，
是走出教室後大家開始對答案，然後我一題一題安靜地陣亡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考完在走廊對答案、越對越絕望時發文，考完才知道自己全錯的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「對答案這件事，就是花五分鐘親手確認我這科掰了。」
進階版：「我考完本來心情還不錯，直到有人開口問『第三題你選什麼』。」

en.content:
The most thrilling part of an exam isn't the exam itself,
it's walking out and everyone starts comparing answers while I quietly die one question at a time.
en.editorNote: Post it when comparing answers in the hallway only sinks your heart lower — anyone who learns they bombed it right after the exam gets this.
variations: Swap in: "Comparing answers is just spending five minutes personally confirming that I flunked this one."
Harder mode: "I actually felt fine after the exam, until someone asked, 'hey, what'd you put for number three?'"

items.sourceNote: 學校暑假閱讀心得作業字數規定 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
暑假閱讀心得規定一千字起跳，
我準時交出一千零五字，但那本書我只翻過封底——因為簡介真的寫得最精華。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前一晚趕閱讀心得、書卻只翻了兩頁時發，同班同學看到會直接對號入座。
variations: 也能換成：「我寫心得的速度，比我讀那本書的速度快了大概十倍。」
進階版：「老師問我最喜歡書裡哪個角色，我沉默了三秒，然後說：『封面設計的人。』」

en.content:
The summer book report has a 1,000-word minimum,
I turned in 1,005 on time, but the only page I ever opened was the back cover — honestly the blurb had all the good parts.
en.editorNote: Post it the night before school starts, when the report is done and the book is not — every classmate will recognize themselves.
variations: Swap in: "I wrote the report about ten times faster than I read the book."
Harder mode: "Teacher asked who my favorite character was. I paused, then said, 'whoever designed the cover.'"

items.sourceNote: 開學前調整作息建議 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
開學倒數一個月，我決定開始收心、把作息調回來，
於是我提早三小時躺上床——然後提早三小時開始滑手機，最後還是四點才睡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 八月開始喊要調作息卻天天破功時發，適合配一張凌晨四點的手機截圖。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是睡不著，我只是在跟明天的自己談判。」
進階版：「我的收心操目前只做到『把鬧鐘設好』這一步，設好之後我就繼續熬夜了。」

en.content:
One month till school starts, so I decided to fix my sleep schedule,
which meant getting into bed three hours earlier — and starting to scroll three hours earlier. Still fell asleep at 4am.
en.editorNote: For August, when you announce you're resetting your sleep schedule and break the promise nightly. Pairs well with a 4am screenshot.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not having trouble sleeping, I'm negotiating with tomorrow-me."
Harder mode: "My whole back-to-school reset so far is setting an alarm, and then staying up anyway."

items.sourceNote: 暑假規劃與開學後上傳成果建議 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
老師要我們整理暑假的成果，開學交上去。
我打開相簿翻素材，整個七月只有外送截圖、我房間的天花板，還有一張沒對到焦的雲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被要求交暑假成果、卻發現自己什麼都沒留下時發，配一張相簿截圖效果最好。
variations: 也能換成：「我這個暑假唯一持續累積的東西，是外送 App 的消費紀錄。」
進階版：「要我交暑假成果可以，但我的成果是我終於知道哪一家滷肉飯最快送到。」

en.content:
Teacher wants us to put together what we accomplished over the break and hand it in on day one.
I opened my camera roll to look for material — all of July is delivery receipts, my bedroom ceiling, and one out-of-focus cloud.
en.editorNote: For when someone asks what you did all summer and the camera roll answers for you. Screenshot the camera roll for maximum damage.
variations: Swap in: "The only thing I built up this summer was my order history."
Harder mode: "Sure, I'll submit my summer achievements: I know exactly which place delivers fastest now."

items.sourceNote: 學生暑期打工現況 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
打工兩個月，我沒學到什麼了不起的專業技能，
但我現在可以一邊被客人念，一邊把嘴角維持在標準的十五度。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假打工做到快尾聲、對人類徹底改觀時發，服務業同伴看了會默默點頭。
variations: 也能換成：「這個暑假教會我的不是專業，是表情管理。」
進階版：「我的時薪買下的不只是勞力，還有我把『我沒有義務』這五個字吞回去的能力。」

en.content:
Two months at this job and I picked up exactly zero marketable skills,
but I can now hold a perfect fifteen-degree smile while a customer lectures me.
en.editorNote: For the tail end of a summer job, once retail has rewired your opinion of humanity. Every service worker will nod.
variations: Swap in: "This summer didn't teach me a trade, it taught me face control."
Harder mode: "My hourly wage doesn't just buy my labor, it buys my ability to swallow the words 'that's not my job.'"

items.sourceNote: 115學年度暑假天數與輔導課安排 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
行事曆上寫著暑假六十天，
扣掉輔導課、扣掉補習、扣掉那疊還沒動的作業，真正屬於我的大概是四個下午。
zh-tw.editorNote: 七月底盤點暑假剩下什麼時發，適合貼在滿滿是課的行事曆旁邊。
variations: 也能換成：「我的暑假是那種名字聽起來很自由、行程表看起來很上學的東西。」
進階版：「別人問我暑假過得怎樣，我只能說：我換了一間教室，冷氣還比較弱。」

en.content:
The calendar says summer break is sixty days.
Minus the extra classes, minus cram school, minus the stack of homework I haven't touched, what's actually mine works out to about four afternoons.
en.editorNote: For late July, when you tally up what's left of the break. Pairs perfectly with a calendar that's already full.
variations: Swap in: "My summer break is one of those things that sounds free and schedules like school."
Harder mode: "People ask how my summer's going and all I can say is: I switched classrooms, and this one has worse AC."

items.sourceNote: 115 學年度暑期全校返校日行程公告；返校打掃日教室桌椅堆置實況原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
返校打掃日回到教室，桌椅全被疊到牆邊，
我站在門口找了半分鐘才認出自己的位子——原來這間教室少了我，也照樣過得很好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑假返校打掃日踏進空教室時發文，配一張桌椅疊成一座山的照片最有畫面。
variations: 也能換成：「兩個月沒人來，教室裡最有精神的是牆邊那盆沒人管的植物。」
進階版：「返校日的任務是打掃，我實際完成的是站在窗邊回想我上學期坐在哪。」

en.content:
Back in the classroom for the summer cleanup day, every desk and chair is stacked against the wall.
I stood in the doorway half a minute before I recognized my own spot — turns out this room gets along just fine without me.
en.editorNote: Post it the moment you walk into the empty classroom on cleanup day; best paired with a photo of desks piled into a mountain.
variations: Swap in: "Nobody's been here for two months and the liveliest thing in the room is the plant nobody waters."
Harder mode: "The assignment was to clean. What I actually accomplished was standing by the window trying to remember where I used to sit."

items.sourceNote: Threads 開學制服採買討論；開學前試穿舊制服的自嘲原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
開學前把去年的制服翻出來試穿，褲頭扣起來的難度明顯比記憶中高。
我一度懷疑是洗衣機把它洗縮水了，可是這兩個月它連洗衣籃都沒進去過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前整理制服、發現尺寸有話要說時發文，暑假過得太爽的同學都會默默按讚。
variations: 也能換成：「制服沒變，是我這個暑假很努力地在長大。」
進階版：「試穿完我做了一個成熟的決定：先把它掛回衣櫃，開學那天再說。」

en.content:
Dug last year's school uniform out to try on before the new term, and the waistband is noticeably harder to button than I remembered.
For a second I blamed the washing machine for shrinking it — except it hasn't even been in the laundry basket for two months.
en.editorNote: For sorting out your uniform before school starts and discovering the sizing has opinions. Anyone who enjoyed their summer will quietly like it.
variations: Swap in: "The uniform didn't change. I just worked really hard on growing this summer."
Harder mode: "After trying it on I made a mature decision: hang it back up and deal with it on day one."

items.sourceNote: 115 學年度八月底開學日程報導；開學前看分班名單的社交焦慮原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
分班名單貼出來，我最在意的不是自己被分到哪一班，
是用手指從第一行掃到最後一行，確認裡面有沒有一個開學那天能一起吃午餐的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前查分班名單、心裡在跑另一套計算時發文，社恐同學會秒懂那根手指的重量。
variations: 也能換成：「名單上三十幾個名字，我認得的那兩個，決定了我這一年的幸福指數。」
進階版：「別人看分班名單是看導師是誰，我是在算逃生路線。」

en.content:
The new class lists went up, and what I actually care about isn't which class I landed in.
It's running my finger from the first name to the last, checking whether there's one person I could eat lunch with on day one.
en.editorNote: For checking the class assignment list before term starts while running a completely different calculation in your head. The socially anxious will feel the weight of that finger.
variations: Swap in: "Thirty-odd names on that list, and the two I recognize decide my happiness for the whole year."
Harder mode: "Other people read the class list to see who the homeroom teacher is. I read it to map my escape routes."

items.sourceNote: 114/115 學年度開學與暑假日程報導；暑輔結束到開學之間的空窗期原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
暑輔最後一天走出校門，我在心裡放了一場煙火，覺得自由終於來了。
然後我點開日曆——距離開學，還剩十一天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑輔結束當天發限動最有感，同校同學會在留言區一起哀號那個數字。
variations: 也能換成：「我的暑假不是兩個月，是暑輔和開學中間那條縫。」
進階版：「放暑假、上暑輔、開學，三個詞連在一起唸完，我的暑假就結束了。」

en.content:
Walking out the gate on the last day of mandatory summer classes, I threw myself a private fireworks show — freedom at last.
Then I opened my calendar. Eleven days until the new term.
en.editorNote: Post this the day summer classes end. Anyone from your school will show up in the replies to scream about that number.
variations: Swap in: "My summer break isn't two months. It's the crack between summer classes and day one."
Harder mode: "Say 'break, summer school, new semester' out loud and congratulations, your vacation is over."

items.sourceNote: 2026 開學日程懶人包；開學前理髮應付儀容檢查的台灣校園在地共感原創

zh-tw.content:
開學前一天去剪頭髮，設計師問我想留多長，
我想了三秒說：「請剪成一個不會被叫去操場罰站的長度。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 被儀容檢查支配過的人都懂，適合配一張剪完頭髮的自拍發限動。
variations: 也能換成：「別人剪頭髮是為了變帥，我剪頭髮是為了活過禮拜一的朝會。」
進階版：「我這顆頭的審美標準，從來不是我決定的。」

en.content:
Got a haircut the day before school starts. The stylist asked how long I wanted to keep it.
I thought about it for three seconds and said, "Short enough that nobody makes me stand on the field as punishment."
en.editorNote: For anyone whose hairstyle has always been dictated by a dress-code inspection. Pair it with a fresh-cut selfie.
variations: Swap in: "Other people get haircuts to look good. I get haircuts to survive Monday assembly."
Harder mode: "I have never once been the person deciding what my own head looks like."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 暑假安排話題；暑期工讀生開學前想辭職卻被留下來排假日班的原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
我鼓起勇氣跟店長說：「不好意思，我開學就不能來了。」
他頭也沒抬地回：「那就排週末。」——於是我的暑假沒有結束，它只是換了個班表繼續。
zh-tw.editorNote: 暑期工讀生開學前提辭職失敗時發文，打工族群會在留言區認親。
variations: 也能換成：「辭職信我寫了三個版本，店長只用四個字就退回了。」
進階版：「我以為開學是解脫，結果只是從全職累改成半職累。」

en.content:
I worked up the nerve to tell my manager, "Sorry, I can't come in once school starts."
Without looking up he said, "Weekends, then." So my summer job didn't end. It just switched schedules.
en.editorNote: For the summer hire whose resignation got politely overruled. Every part-timer will claim you in the replies.
variations: Swap in: "I drafted my resignation three times. My manager killed it in four words."
Harder mode: "I thought the new semester was an escape. Turns out I just went from full-time tired to part-time tired."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 暑假安排話題；開學前班級群組突然復活的原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
班群安靜了整整兩個月，昨天有人丟了一句「欸暑假作業有人寫完嗎」。
三分鐘後跳出四十七則未讀，沒有一個人回答那個問題。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學前一週班群突然復活時發文，被那四十七則洗版過的人都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「班群復活的方式只有兩種：問作業，還有問誰有寫。」
進階版：「我點開班群不是要找答案，是要確認還有人跟我一樣什麼都沒寫。」

en.content:
The class group chat was dead for two straight months. Yesterday someone dropped: "anyone actually finished the summer homework?"
Three minutes later: forty-seven unread messages, and not one of them answered the question.
en.editorNote: For the week the class chat rises from the dead. Anyone who's been buried under those forty-seven messages will get it.
variations: Swap in: "A class group chat only revives for two reasons: asking about homework, and asking who did the homework."
Harder mode: "I don't open the chat for answers. I open it to confirm somebody else is as far behind as I am."

items.sourceNote: 2026 各級學校開學日差異（中小學八月底、大學九月初）；手足開學日落差的原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
我妹八月底就要背書包出門，我九月才開學。
這一個禮拜的時差，是我整個暑假唯一贏過她的東西——順帶一提，她的暑假作業已經寫完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 大學生對上還在念中學的手足時發文，家裡有兄弟姊妹的都會被戳到。
variations: 也能換成：「我贏在開學晚一週，輸在其他三百五十八天。」
進階版：「我妹問我這個暑假做了什麼，我說我在等她先開學。」

en.content:
My little sister goes back at the end of August. I don't start until September.
That one-week gap is the only thing I beat her at all summer — and by the way, she already finished her homework.
en.editorNote: For the college student comparing calendars with a younger sibling still in middle or high school. Anyone with siblings will feel it.
variations: Swap in: "I win by one week of vacation and lose on the other three hundred fifty-eight days."
Harder mode: "My sister asked what I did this summer. I told her I was waiting for her to go back first."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
新學期第一堂課，老師說：「來，每個人簡單自我介紹一下。」
我前面那位同學講了興趣、專長、還有人生規劃，輪到我的時候，我說完名字就沒有下一句了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學第一週被點名自我介紹、腦袋當場空白時發文，社恐同學會集體舉手。
variations: 也能換成：「我從第一個人開始就在心裡打草稿，輪到我還是只講得出名字跟『請多指教』。」
進階版：「自我介紹最難的不是介紹自己，是要在三十秒內想出一個聽起來不廢的興趣。」

en.content:
First class of the new term, the teacher says, "Everyone give a quick intro."
The person before me covers their hobbies, their skills, and their five-year plan. My turn: I say my name and then there is no second sentence.
en.editorNote: Post it during week one when you get called on to introduce yourself and your brain goes blank. Every socially anxious classmate will raise a hand.
variations: Swap in: "I started drafting from person number one and still only managed my name and 'nice to meet you'."
Harder mode: "The hard part isn't introducing yourself, it's inventing a hobby that doesn't sound sad in under thirty seconds."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
上課前手機要統一放進講台旁邊那個袋子，
我把它放進去的那一刻，才發現我這個人有一半的個性，是靠那五吋螢幕撐起來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 手機被集中保管的第一節課發文，被迫戒斷的同學會回「我也是」。
variations: 也能換成：「手機交出去之後，我這五十分鐘唯一能做的事，就是重新認識這個世界。」
進階版：「我的手機在袋子裡震了一下，那一下震的其實是我的心。」

en.content:
Before class we all have to drop our phones into the pouch by the teacher's desk.
The second mine goes in, I realize roughly half my personality was being held up by a five-inch screen.
en.editorNote: Post it after the first class where phones get collected. Fellow forced-detox students will reply 'same'.
variations: Swap in: "With my phone gone, the only thing left to do for fifty minutes is get reacquainted with reality."
Harder mode: "My phone buzzed once inside the pouch, and honestly the thing that jolted was me."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
社團博覽會走一圈，我被學長姐熱情攔下六次，
最後帶回來三張報名表、兩個沒興趣的社群，和一個「下週要不要來看看」的承諾。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學社團招生週被連環搭訕後發文，臉皮薄的大學生都懂那種難以拒絕。
variations: 也能換成：「我本來只是路過拿免費飲料，現在我好像是三個社團的準幹部。」
進階版：「加入社團那天我熱血沸騰，兩個月後我連社課在哪間教室都忘了。」

en.content:
One lap around the club fair and six upperclassmen flag me down.
I come back with three sign-up forms, two group chats I don't care about, and a promise to "maybe swing by next week."
en.editorNote: Post it after club recruitment week ambushes you. Any student who can't say no will feel seen.
variations: Swap in: "I only walked past for the free drink and somehow I'm now on the board of three clubs."
Harder mode: "I joined fired up on day one; two months later I can't even remember which room the meetings are in."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
開學前一週，我開始做同一個夢：
我在走廊上一間一間找教室，鐘聲一直響，而我手上那張課表印的全是空白。
zh-tw.editorNote: 開學倒數的焦慮夢，半夜驚醒後發限動，收假症候群發作的同學會秒懂。
variations: 也能換成：「夢裡我遲到、走錯教室、還忘記帶課本；醒來看時間，離開學還有七天。」
進階版：「我的身體還在放假，我的潛意識已經先去上學了。」

en.content:
The week before school starts, I keep having the same dream:
I'm going door to door down a hallway looking for my classroom, the bell won't stop ringing, and the schedule in my hand is completely blank.
en.editorNote: The countdown-to-school anxiety dream. Post it after waking up at 3 a.m.; anyone with back-to-school dread will get it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "In the dream I'm late, in the wrong room, and missing my textbook. I wake up: still seven days to go."
Harder mode: "My body is still on vacation, but my subconscious already went back to school."

items.sourceNote: 大一新生住宿討論 搬宿舍行李共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
搬進宿舍那天，我的行李箱塞了電風扇、除濕機、還有三箱說要好好讀的書；
一個月後真正天天在用的，只有那條從家裡順走的舊毛巾。
zh-tw.editorNote: 住宿一陣子後回頭看行李清單時發文，住宿生都懂那種「帶什麼都不對」的無力。
variations: 也能換成：「宿舍教我的第一課：你以為的必需品，最後都變成床底下的裝飾品。」
進階版：「行李箱裝的是我對宿舍生活的想像，開箱之後才發現尺寸完全不合。」

en.content:
The day I moved into the dorm, my suitcase had a fan, a dehumidifier, and three boxes of books I swore I'd read.
A month later, the only thing I use every single day is the old towel I stole from home.
en.editorNote: Post it once dorm life sets in and you review your packing list. Every resident knows the 'nothing I brought was right' feeling.
variations: Swap in: "First lesson of dorm life: everything you called essential ends up decorating the space under your bed."
Harder mode: "My suitcase was packed with my fantasy of dorm life, and the size was completely wrong."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 大學生打工時薪討論 價格換算共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
看到想買的東西，我的第一個反應不是看價錢，
是在心裡算這要在櫃檯站幾個小時——通常算著算著，就不想買了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 半工半讀的省錢日常，打過工的同學都懂那個自動換算的本能。
variations: 也能換成：「這杯手搖三十五塊，換算下來是我擦二十分鐘的桌子。」
進階版：「打工最大的副作用，是我從此看什麼都先換算成『幾小時』。」

en.content:
When I see something I want, my first instinct isn't to check the price —
it's to calculate how many hours that is behind the counter. Usually the math itself talks me out of it.
en.editorNote: Everyday frugality for the working student. Anyone with a part-time job knows this reflex conversion.
variations: Swap in: "This bubble tea is four bucks, which is twenty minutes of me wiping tables."
Harder mode: "The biggest side effect of a part-time job is that I now price everything in hours."

items.sourceNote: 通勤生車上趕作業 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
公車過了三站，我的作業寫完兩題；
第四站司機一個煞車，我的字就從中文變成了心電圖。
zh-tw.editorNote: 通勤族在車上趕作業的日常災難，同路線的同學看了會直接笑出來。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是在通勤，我是在一間會晃的自習室裡跟物理定律搏鬥。」
進階版：「通勤一小時，我可以睡完一輪、醒來，然後開始後悔昨天沒早點寫。」

en.content:
Three stops into the bus ride I'd finished two questions;
at the fourth stop the driver hit the brakes and my handwriting turned into an EKG readout.
en.editorNote: The daily disaster of doing homework mid-commute. Anyone on the same route will laugh out loud.
variations: Swap in: "I'm not commuting, I'm fighting physics inside a study room that keeps swaying."
Harder mode: "An hour of commuting is enough to nap, wake up, and start regretting not doing this last night."

items.sourceNote: 社團幹部交接 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
學長姐畢業前把社團交給我，說：「很簡單，照著以前做就好。」
交接資料夾打開，裡面只有一張三年前的活動照片，和兩個字：加油。
zh-tw.editorNote: 接下幹部才發現前人什麼都沒留下的無語瞬間，當過社團幹部的都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我當上幹部那天才知道，社辦鑰匙在誰手上是全社最大的謎題。」
進階版：「社團招到二十個新血，開會現場永遠是固定那四張臉。」

en.content:
The seniors handed me the club before graduating and said, "It's easy, just do what we did."
I opened the handover folder: one photo from an event three years ago, and the words "good luck."
en.editorNote: The speechless moment of taking over a club officer role and finding nothing was documented. Every former officer knows it.
variations: Swap in: "The day I became an officer I learned that who has the clubroom key is the club's greatest unsolved mystery."
Harder mode: "We recruited twenty new members, and every meeting is the same four faces."

items.sourceNote: 教授講義多年未更新 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
教授簡報右下角的日期，停在我還在念小學的那一年，
難怪他每次舉例都要先解釋一遍——那些例子，比班上一半的人都老。
zh-tw.editorNote: 上課看到十幾年沒更新的講義時發文，同堂同學會在底下留言認領年份。
variations: 也能換成：「講義上的網址我點進去，跳出來的是一片空白——跟我上完課的腦袋一樣。」
進階版：「教授說這份講義『每年都會微調』，我猜微調的是頁碼。」

en.content:
The date in the corner of my professor's slides is from back when I was in elementary school.
No wonder he explains every example before using it — those examples are older than half the class.
en.editorNote: Post it when you spot lecture slides that haven't been updated in a decade. Classmates will show up in the comments to name the year.
variations: Swap in: "I clicked the link on the handout and got a blank page — same as my brain after that lecture."
Harder mode: "The professor says he 'tweaks the slides every year.' I think the tweak is the page numbers."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 教學意見調查沒填會怎樣 校務系統卡成績 共感改寫

zh-tw.content:
想看成績，得先把教學意見調查填完。
於是我對著一門差點把我當掉的課，一路點滿五顆星，還在建議欄寫下「老師教得很好」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 成績公布日被系統卡在問卷頁面時發文，全校同學都做過同一件違心的事。
variations: 也能換成：「問卷匿名不匿名我不知道，我只知道我的手比我的良心誠實。」
進階版：「填完二十份問卷，系統跟我說『成績尚未上傳』——那我剛剛是在對誰掏心掏肺。」

en.content:
You can't see your grades until you finish the course evaluation.
So I gave five stars to the class that nearly failed me, and typed "great instructor" in the comments box.
en.editorNote: Post it on grade-release day when the system holds your transcript hostage behind a survey. Every student has told the same lie.
variations: Swap in: "I don't know if the survey is really anonymous, I only know my clicking hand is more honest than my conscience."
Harder mode: "Filled out twenty evaluations and the system said 'grades not yet uploaded.' So who exactly was I pouring my heart out to?"

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
體適能檢測我年年都測，年年退步。
唯一一項有明顯進步的，是我解釋自己為什麼退步的速度。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被抓去測坐姿體前彎、立定跳遠之後發文，體育課躲不掉的同學會集體嘆氣。
variations: 也能換成：「仰臥起坐一分鐘，我前十五秒在做，後四十五秒在思考人生。」
進階版：「我不是體力差，我只是把所有肌肉都拿去撐期末週了。」

en.content:
I take the fitness test every year and score worse every year.
The only thing that's measurably improved is how fast I can explain why I got worse.
en.editorNote: Post it after being dragged through sit-and-reach and standing jumps. Anyone who can't dodge P.E. will sigh in unison.
variations: Swap in: "One minute of sit-ups: I spend fifteen seconds doing them and forty-five reflecting on my life."
Harder mode: "I'm not out of shape, I just spent all my muscle getting through finals week."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
宿舍抽籤結果出來，我沒中。
這是我人生第一次抽獎抽到最後一刻，然後發現獎品是「請自行在外面找地方住」。
zh-tw.editorNote: 抽宿舍落空、開始翻租屋網時發文，同屆沒抽到床位的人會在底下抱團。
variations: 也能換成：「我的運氣全用在分組沒抽到雷隊友，剩下的額度不夠抽宿舍。」
進階版：「候補順位第八十七號，我決定先去問問看校門口那間有沒有月租。」

en.content:
Dorm lottery results came out and I didn't get in.
First time in my life I've made it to the final draw, only to find the prize is "please go find somewhere else to live."
en.editorNote: Post it when you strike out on housing and start scrolling rental listings. Everyone else without a bed will pile into the comments.
variations: Swap in: "I used all my luck avoiding a nightmare group project. There wasn't enough left for the housing draw."
Harder mode: "Waitlist number eighty-seven. I'm going to go ask that building by the front gate about monthly rates."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
家長日那天我在家等，想像老師會說什麼。
我媽回來只講了一句「老師說你很有潛力」，然後把飯放到我面前，全程沒有再看我一眼。
zh-tw.editorNote: 親師座談會結束、家裡氣壓變低那晚發文，被「很有潛力」四個字傷過的人都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「老師誇我『人很乖』的時候，我就知道成績那段被跳過了。」
進階版：「家長日結束後家裡特別安靜，安靜到我開始主動說要去洗碗。」

en.content:
I waited at home on parent-teacher night, imagining what my teacher would say.
My mom came back with exactly one line — "she says you have a lot of potential" — then set dinner in front of me without looking at me once.
en.editorNote: Post it the night the air pressure at home drops after conferences. Anyone who's been wounded by the word "potential" gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The second a teacher calls me 'well-behaved,' I know they skipped the part about my grades."
Harder mode: "The house got so quiet after parent-teacher night that I volunteered to do the dishes."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
寢室冷氣卡沒錢，四個人湊錢去儲值，只有一個人說「我不吹，我不出」。
那天半夜三點，我起來上廁所，看到他躺在出風口正下方，睡得比誰都香。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合分攤寢室費用被卡住那晚發限動，住過四人房的都懂那種無力感。
variations: 也能換成：「他說他不吹冷氣，結果他的棉被是全寢唯一蓋到脖子的。」
進階版：「寢室最公平的制度，是冷氣卡的錢大家一起出；最不公平的，是風向。」

en.content:
The dorm AC card ran out, so four of us chipped in to top it up. One guy said, "I don't use it, I'm not paying."
At 3 a.m. I got up for the bathroom and found him lying directly under the vent, sleeping better than any of us.
en.editorNote: Post it the night splitting a dorm utility bill goes sideways. Anyone who's shared a four-person room knows the feeling.
variations: Swap in: "He swore he never uses the AC, yet his is the only blanket in the room pulled up to the chin."
Harder mode: "The fairest thing in our dorm is splitting the AC card. The least fair thing is which way the vent points."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
當上社長之後，我辦了第一次社課。
那天到場七個人，其中六個是幹部，剩下那一個是走錯教室的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合社團招不到人、幹部群裡一片死寂的時候發，小社團的社長都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「社課簽到表上的名字，有一半是我們自己人輪流簽的。」
進階版：「我們社團最穩定的出席紀錄，是那台永遠準時到場的投影機。」

en.content:
I became club president and ran my first session.
Seven people showed up. Six were officers, and the seventh had walked into the wrong room.
en.editorNote: For when club recruitment flops and the officer group chat goes silent. Every small-club president knows this one.
variations: Swap in: "Half the names on our sign-in sheet are just officers taking turns."
Harder mode: "The most reliable attendee our club has is the projector, and it shows up on time every week."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
凌晨三點，共編文件右上角掛著五顆頭像，代表全組都在線上。
可是整份文件只有我這個游標在動，其他四個安安靜靜地，像四盞守夜的路燈。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合小組報告死線前一晚、你一個人扛完的時候發，配上文件截圖更有說服力。
variations: 也能換成：「他們在線上，只是在線上看我寫。」
進階版：「共編文件最溫馨的功能，就是讓你清清楚楚知道，是誰全程沒動過。」

en.content:
3 a.m., and five avatars sit in the corner of the shared doc — the whole group is online.
But mine is the only cursor moving. The other four just hover there quietly, like four streetlights keeping watch.
en.editorNote: For the night before a group project is due when you're carrying it alone. Pair it with a screenshot of the doc.
variations: Swap in: "They were online, sure. Online watching me type."
Harder mode: "The warmest feature of a shared doc is showing you exactly who never touched it."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
我花三個晚上把簡報排到每一行都對齊。
接到教室那台電腦，字型全部變成預設，圖片跑到標題上面，我只好站在台上說：「它原本不是長這樣。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合上台報告翻車後發，做過簡報的人看到「它原本不是長這樣」都會笑出來。
variations: 也能換成：「報告當天我最需要的不是講稿，是一顆能用的轉接頭。」
進階版：「排版三個晚上，毀滅只需要教室電腦開機的那三秒。」

en.content:
I spent three nights getting every line of my slides perfectly aligned.
Plugged into the classroom computer and every font reverted to default, an image landed on top of the title, and all I could say from the podium was, "It didn't look like this before."
en.editorNote: For after a presentation goes off the rails. Anyone who's built slides laughs at "it didn't look like this before."
variations: Swap in: "On presentation day, what I really needed wasn't my script. It was one working adapter."
Harder mode: "Three nights of formatting, undone in the three seconds it took the classroom PC to boot."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
服務學習時數還差八小時，登記系統下週就關。
我一口氣報了三場淨灘、兩場整理圖書，然後看著那張表默默承認：我對社會的愛，是被截止日逼出來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合時數快來不及、瘋狂搶場次那週發，被時數追殺過的都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我這學期最有效率的一天，是為了補時數搬了四小時的書。」
進階版：「時數表上寫著八小時，我心裡寫的是『早知道大一就慢慢做』。」

en.content:
Eight service hours short, and the sign-up system closes next week.
I signed up for three beach cleanups and two library shifts in one sitting, then stared at the list and admitted it: my love for society runs entirely on deadlines.
en.editorNote: For the week you're scrambling to grab any slot left. Anyone chased by a service-hour requirement gets it.
variations: Swap in: "My single most productive day this term was four hours of shelving books to make up hours."
Harder mode: "The form says eight hours. My head says, 'should've spread this out back in freshman year.'"

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
實驗數據跟課本理論差了快四成。
我在報告最後寫了整整一頁「誤差來源」，室溫、儀器老舊、讀數視角、空氣阻力全都怪過一輪，就是沒寫那句真的：我第三步驟量錯了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合實驗課報告交出去那晚發，寫過誤差分析的理工科都會心虛地笑。
variations: 也能換成：「我這學期最有創意的寫作，全部集中在誤差分析那一段。」
進階版：「數據不會騙人，但我的誤差來源那一頁會。」

en.content:
My lab data came out almost forty percent off the textbook value.
So I wrote a full page of "sources of error" — room temperature, aging equipment, reading angle, air resistance — everything except the true one: I messed up step three.
en.editorNote: For the night you submit a lab report. Any STEM student who's padded an error analysis will wince and laugh.
variations: Swap in: "My most creative writing this semester lives entirely in the error analysis section."
Harder mode: "Data doesn't lie. My sources-of-error page absolutely does."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
停修截止日那天，我把游標移到「確認停修」上面，又移開，來回七次。
最後我關掉頁面說：「再撐一下，說不定會有奇蹟。」期末成績出來，奇蹟確實發生了——只是發生在別人身上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合停修截止日或成績公布那天發，猶豫過要不要停修的人一秒代入。
variations: 也能換成：「我對那門課唯一的努力，就是反覆考慮要不要停修。」
進階版：「停修那顆按鈕，是我整學期最認真研究的教材。」

en.content:
On the last day to drop, I hovered over "confirm withdrawal" and moved away seven times.
Then I closed the tab and said, "I'll tough it out, maybe a miracle happens." Finals came out and a miracle did happen — to somebody else.
en.editorNote: For drop deadline day or the day grades post. Anyone who's agonized over withdrawing gets it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "The only effort I put into that class was repeatedly considering dropping it."
Harder mode: "That withdrawal button was the course material I studied hardest all term."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
教學評量開放那週，成績還沒公布。
我在「這門課讓我收穫良多」勾了非常同意。三週後成績出來，我才想起來：那份問卷不是評量，是求情。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合期末填評量或成績公布後發，寫過違心好評的學生都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我填評量的誠實程度，跟成績公布日期成正比。」
進階版：「教學評量最公正的版本，永遠是我看到成績之後心裡默默寫的那一份。」

en.content:
Course evaluations opened the week before grades posted.
I marked "strongly agree" on "I gained a great deal from this course." Three weeks later my grade came out and it hit me: that form wasn't feedback, it was a plea bargain.
en.editorNote: For evaluation week or grade release day. Anyone who's left a dishonestly kind review will recognize themselves.
variations: Swap in: "How honest my course evaluation is depends entirely on when grades drop."
Harder mode: "My fairest course evaluation is the one I write in my head after seeing the grade."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
買半票的時候，我遞出學生證的手比交考卷還抖。
店員看都沒看就過了，我卻鬆了一大口氣——因為這張卡，是我目前身上唯一還在生效的優勢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合買學生票、或聊到快畢業時發，靠學生身分省錢的人都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我這輩子最保值的證件，四年後就要自動失效了。」
進階版：「別人靠實力打折，我靠一張還沒過期的學生證。」

en.content:
Handing over my student ID for the discount, my hand shook more than it does turning in an exam.
The cashier didn't even look and rang it up, and I exhaled hard — because that card is the only advantage I currently have that's still valid.
en.editorNote: For buying a student-priced ticket, or any chat about graduating soon. Anyone living off the student discount gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The most valuable ID I'll ever own expires automatically in four years."
Harder mode: "Some people earn their discount. I just have an ID that hasn't expired yet."

items.sourceNote: 收假症候群症狀說明 學生版共感原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
我上網查「收假症候群」，跳出來的全是上班族版本：星期天晚上莫名低落，星期一早上特別想賴床。
我把日曆翻到八月底算了一下——原來我的星期天晚上，已經提早二十一天開始了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合暑假只剩最後三週、心情開始有感的那個晚上發，同學看到「提早二十一天」會笑著說自己也是。
variations: 也能換成：「上班族的收假症候群只有一個晚上，學生版是限量加長版，還附贈作業。」
進階版：「我還沒開學就先收完假了，這大概是我今年唯一提前完成的事。」

en.content:
Back-to-school blues, according to every article I found, is an office thing: you feel low on Sunday night and hate getting up on Monday.
Then I counted what's left on my calendar and realized my Sunday night started three weeks early.
en.editorNote: For the night the end of summer break finally sinks in. Classmates will reply that theirs started early too.
variations: Swap in: "Office workers get one bad Sunday night. The student edition is the extended cut, and it comes with homework."
Harder mode: "I finished my break before the break finished. Only thing I've ever done ahead of schedule."

items.sourceNote: 開學收心操衛教三步驟 學生自嘲角度原創改寫

zh-tw.content:
大人從小就叫我們開學前要做「收心操」，我認真找過動作說明，找了很多年都沒找到。
後來才發現這套操只有一個動作：把手機放下。而我從第一下就做不標準。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合被家人念一句「該收心了」的那天發，配一張手機還握在手上的照片最有畫面。
variations: 也能換成：「收心操我做得很勤，只是每做一下就要休息二十分鐘，滑個手機當暖身。」
進階版：「我三個禮拜前就開始收心，收到現在心還在原地，只有日期在動。」

en.content:
Refocus drills are what adults tell you to do before school starts. I spent years hunting for the actual instructions and never found any.
Turns out the routine has exactly one move: put the phone down. I've been failing rep one since June.
en.editorNote: For the day someone at home tells you it's time to snap out of vacation mode. Best with a photo of the phone still in your hand.
variations: Swap in: "I practice my refocus routine constantly. One rep, then twenty minutes of scrolling as a warm-down."
Harder mode: "I started pulling myself together three weeks ago. Nothing has moved except the dates."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
開學前一晚把書包整個倒過來，掉出三支乾掉的原子筆、一張忘記交的回條，還有一張被壓到發皺的紙條，上面只寫著「下課福利社」。
我本來一點都不想開學的，看完那張紙條，突然有點想見到他們。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前一晚整理書包時發，翻出舊紙條的那一刻，同班的人看到會直接標記你。
variations: 也能換成：「書包最底層是一個獨立的時區，那裡的時間停在放假前的最後一堂課。」
進階版：「整理書包花了兩小時，其中一個半小時是在看那些早就該丟、但我還是留著的東西。」

en.content:
Backpack turned upside down the night before school starts: three dead pens, a permission slip I never handed in, and a crumpled note that just said "snack bar after class."
I wasn't ready to go back at all. Then I read the note and realized I kind of miss them.
en.editorNote: For the night-before backpack cleanout. Post it the moment an old note falls out and your classmates will tag you.
variations: Swap in: "The bottom of a backpack is its own time zone, permanently stuck at the last class before break."
Harder mode: "Two hours to clean out my bag, ninety minutes of it spent looking at things I should have thrown away and didn't."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
整學期沒出現過的同學，在考前一晚敲我：「欸，可以借一下筆記嗎？」
我往上滑對話紀錄，我們上一次講話停在學期第一週，內容是他問我這堂課的教室在哪裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合考前被幾乎不認識的同學敲來借筆記那晚發，抄了一整學期筆記的人都會苦笑。
variations: 也能換成：「我的筆記在期末的流通量，比那堂課的出席率高上好幾倍。」
進階版：「他借走筆記那天很熱情地說要請我喝飲料，那杯飲料到現在還停留在心意的階段。」

en.content:
Lecture notes bring people together. The classmate who never showed up all semester messaged me the night before the exam: "Hey, can I borrow yours?"
I scrolled up our chat. We last spoke in week one, when he asked me where the classroom was.
en.editorNote: For the night a near-stranger asks to borrow your notes. Anyone who took notes all term will laugh through their teeth.
variations: Swap in: "My notes circulate more widely during finals than that class's attendance ever did."
Harder mode: "He promised to buy me a drink for those notes. That drink still exists purely as a thought."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
報告十點截止，我九點四十衝到系辦要印。
印表機吐出第一頁就卡紙，我蹲在地上一張一張把紙抽出來的時候，突然覺得這台機器比教授還了解我——它知道我一定會拖到最後一刻。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合死線前十分鐘遇上印表機卡紙那次發，趕過紙本繳交的人都被這台機器背叛過。
variations: 也能換成：「我對這台印表機的所有了解，全部來自它壞掉的那四分鐘。」
進階版：「死線前的印表機有一種特異功能：平常都好好的，只在你最需要它的時候需要休息。」

en.content:
Printer jams have flawless timing. My paper was due at ten and I sprinted to the department office at 9:40.
It jammed on page one. Crouched on the floor pulling sheets out one at a time, I decided that machine knows me better than my professor does — it knew I'd leave it to the last minute.
en.editorNote: For the ten-minutes-to-deadline paper jam. Anyone who's printed a hard copy in a panic has been betrayed by this machine.
variations: Swap in: "Everything I know about that printer, I learned in the four minutes it was broken."
Harder mode: "Printers near a deadline have one superpower: they run fine all year and need a break exactly when you don't."

items.sourceNote: 開學座位安排 迷因改寫

zh-tw.content:
開學第一天，座位表貼在教室門口，我從最後一排開始往前找，
一路找到講台正前方，才看到自己的名字。這學期我不用擔心會分心了，因為老師的視線就是我的桌墊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學看到座位表、發現自己被排到第一排那天發，被老師近距離籠罩過的人都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「坐第一排唯一的好處是我一定會抬頭，唯一的壞處是我抬頭一定會對到眼。」
進階版：「別人上課是聽課，我上課是全程被近距離監控。」

en.content:
First day back, the seating chart goes up by the classroom door. I start scanning from the back row and work forward,
and I don't find my name until the desk directly facing the podium. No worries about getting distracted this term — the teacher's line of sight is basically my desk mat.
en.editorNote: For the day the seating chart lands you in the front row. Anyone who's been within arm's reach of the teacher all semester gets it.
variations: Swap in: "The only upside of the front row is that I'll definitely look up. The only downside is that looking up means eye contact."
Harder mode: "Everyone else attends class. I get monitored at close range for fifty minutes."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
校務系統又跳出通知，說我的密碼過期了，請設定一組從來沒用過的。
於是我把用了三年的那組後面加一，然後很有信心地告訴自己：這是全新的我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合註冊、選課前被系統逼著改密碼那天發，每學期都在原地打轉的人會笑出來。
variations: 也能換成：「我的資安意識，全靠系統每學期提醒我一次。」
進階版：「我的密碼記得很牢，牢到我可以照順序背出前面三個版本。」

en.content:
The school portal pops up again to tell me my password has expired and I need one I've never used before.
So I took the one I've had for three years and added a 1 to the end, then told myself with total confidence: this is a brand-new me.
en.editorNote: For the forced password reset before registration or course selection — anyone running in place every semester will laugh.
variations: Swap in: "My entire security awareness runs on one reminder from the portal per semester."
Harder mode: "I know my password by heart — well enough to recite the previous three versions in order."

items.sourceNote: 開學前趕作業 迷因改寫

zh-tw.content:
開學前一晚，班群傳作業傳得比整個暑假都還熱絡。
隔天老師發現有六個人的第三題錯得一模一樣，連那個多打的逗號都停在同一個位置。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前一晚全班互相支援暑假作業時發，抄過也被抄過的人都會心虛地笑。
variations: 也能換成：「我不是抄，我只是很尊重原作者的每一個細節。」
進階版：「抄的時候記得故意改錯一題，這是我國中就學會的風險管理。」

en.content:
The night before school starts, the class group chat is livelier than it was all summer, homework flying in every direction.
The next day the teacher noticed six people got question three wrong in exactly the same way — right down to the extra comma sitting in the exact same spot.
en.editorNote: For the night-before homework relay. Anyone who's copied — or been copied from — will laugh a little guiltily.
variations: Swap in: "I didn't copy, I simply respected every detail of the original author's work."
Harder mode: "Always get one answer wrong on purpose. That's risk management I learned in middle school."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
開學第一週分掃地區域，我抽到廁所。
全班安慰我說「廁所很快就掃完啦」，而講這句話的人，剛好全部都抽到走廊。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學分配打掃工作、抽到最雷那區那天發，被安慰得很敷衍的人特別有感。
variations: 也能換成：「我對這個班最大的貢獻，寫在掃具間門口那張名單上。」
進階版：「別人放學是回家，我放學是先去把三間廁所巡完。」

en.content:
First week back, we drew lots for cleaning duty and I pulled the bathrooms.
The whole class reassured me that "bathrooms go fast, don't worry" — and every single person who said that had drawn the hallway.
en.editorNote: For the day cleaning duties get assigned and you pull the worst zone. Hits hardest if the sympathy felt very cheap.
variations: Swap in: "My greatest contribution to this class is written on the list taped to the supply closet door."
Harder mode: "Everyone else goes home after class. I go check three bathrooms first."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
我在二手書社團買到這學期的課本，前一個主人在前面三章畫滿重點，還夾了兩頁手寫筆記。
翻到第四章，一片空白、乾乾淨淨——我看著那條分界線，突然有種被理解的感覺。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合買到二手課本、發現前一個人也讀不完那天發；也很適合拿來自嘲自己的讀書續航力。
variations: 也能換成：「這本書真正的魔王是第四章，因為連上一個人都撐不到那裡。」
進階版：「我決定接手他的進度，從第四章開始畫線——然後畫到第二頁就停了。」

en.content:
Bought this semester's textbook secondhand. The previous owner highlighted the first three chapters and tucked in two pages of handwritten notes.
Chapter four: blank. Spotless. I stared at that dividing line and felt weirdly understood.
en.editorNote: For the day you buy a used textbook and realize the last person quit exactly where you're about to. Good gentle self-roast about study stamina.
variations: Swap in: "Chapter four is the real final boss. Even the last guy didn't make it."
Harder mode: "I decided to pick up where he left off. Got two pages in and stopped."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
開學第一天點名，老師把我的名字唸錯了一個字。
我張嘴想更正，結果同學先笑出來，我就跟著笑了。一個學期過去，那個唸錯的名字，現在我聽到還會自動舉手。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合名字有生僻字、或年年被叫錯的人；開學點名那天發最應景。
variations: 也能換成：「我的名字有兩個版本：身分證上那個，跟老師叫的那個。」
進階版：「畢業典禮唸到我的時候，我還愣了一秒才確定那是在叫我。」

en.content:
First day back, roll call, and the teacher got one character of my name wrong.
I opened my mouth to fix it, but the class laughed first, so I laughed too. One semester later, that wrong name still gets my hand up automatically.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose name gets mangled every single year. Lands best on roll-call day.
variations: Swap in: "I have two names: the one on my ID and the one my teachers use."
Harder mode: "They read my name at graduation and I needed a second to be sure it was mine."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
開學前的體檢，量身高我偷偷把腳跟抬起來，量體重我把書包、外套、連水壺都先拿下來。
護理師報出來的兩個數字，跟去年一模一樣——這一年我什麼都試過了，只有我自己原地不動。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學體檢日、或任何「努力很多但數字沒動」的時刻；語氣輕鬆自嘲，不用真的在意數字。
variations: 也能換成：「我墊腳墊到小腿抽筋，換來的是跟去年一樣的那個數字。」
進階版：「一年之中我唯一維持得很好的，就是我的身高。」

en.content:
Back-to-school checkup. I quietly lifted my heels for the height measurement and stripped off my bag, jacket, even my water bottle for the scale.
The nurse called out two numbers, identical to last year's. I changed everything this year except, apparently, me.
en.editorNote: For checkup day, or any moment where you tried hard and the number didn't budge. Keep it light — the numbers aren't the point.
variations: Swap in: "I stood on my toes until my calves cramped and got last year's number anyway."
Harder mode: "The one thing I've maintained perfectly all year is my height."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
新學期的課表發下來，我第一件事不是看這學期要修什麼，
是用手指從星期一橫著數到星期五，先找出哪一天可以最早離開這裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合課表公布那天發；把「先看放學時間」這個誠實反應講出來，留言區通常會集體承認。
variations: 也能換成：「我對這學期全部的期待，都押在星期三下午那兩節空堂上。」
進階版：「整張課表我唯一看得很仔細的，是最後一節課下課的那個時間。」

en.content:
New semester schedule drops, and the first thing I check isn't which classes I'm taking.
It's running my finger Monday through Friday to find which day I get to leave this place earliest.
en.editorNote: For schedule-release day. Everyone does this and almost nobody admits it out loud.
variations: Swap in: "Every hope I have for this semester is riding on that free block Wednesday afternoon."
Harder mode: "The only cell on that grid I read carefully is when the last class ends."

items.sourceNote: 台灣校園營養午餐值日生抬餐桶、打菜共同記憶 情境改寫

zh-tw.content:
輪到我當值日生打菜，勺子握在手上的那十分鐘，是我在這間教室握過最大的權力：
手往下多沉一點，那個人今天就多一塊排骨。等全班都盛完，我掀開桶子看了一眼，剩下的湯剛好夠我裝滿一碗。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊營養午餐回憶、或午餐時段的貼文；打過菜的人都懂那十分鐘的心理戰，也懂最後一個盛的人會看到什麼。
variations: 也能換成：「打菜的人有全班最短的任期，十分鐘一到，我就變回排在最後面的那一個。」
進階版：「那天我沒有偏心任何人，除了上禮拜借我橡皮擦的那位。」

en.content:
Ladle duty. Ten minutes holding the most power I have ever had in that room — tip it a little deeper and somebody's tray gets the good piece.
Everyone served, I looked in the pot. Exactly one bowl of broth left, and it was mine.
en.editorNote: For school-lunch nostalgia posts or the midday slot. Anyone who ever served the class knows what the pot looks like at the end of the line.
variations: Swap in: "Shortest term of office in the building. Ten minutes, then I'm back at the end of the line."
Harder mode: "Played no favorites that day. Except the kid who lent me an eraser last week."

items.sourceNote: 校園單車停放與無主車清點報導 發想改寫

zh-tw.content:
下課去牽車，整排四十幾台長得幾乎一樣，可是我從來不用找：
龍頭上綁著一條褪色的橘色塑膠繩，是我剛入學那年，家裡的人怕我認錯車幫我綁上去的。到今天還在。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合通勤或校園日常的圖文貼文；那個看起來最醜的記號，往往是全車最捨不得拆的零件。
variations: 也能換成：「我認出自己那台車靠的不是車牌，是後輪擋泥板上那塊乾很久的泥。」
進階版：「整排車都比我的新，可是只有我這台，我從校門口就看得出來。」

en.content:
Forty-odd bikes in the rack, all basically the same, and I never have to look for mine.
Faded orange string on the handlebar, tied there my first week by someone at home who worried I'd grab the wrong one. Still on there.
en.editorNote: Works for commute or campus photo posts. The ugliest thing on the bike is usually the part nobody would ever take off.
variations: Swap in: "I don't find my bike by the lock. I find it by the dried mud on the back fender that's been there since spring."
Harder mode: "Every bike in that row is newer than mine. Mine's the only one I can spot from the gate."

items.sourceNote: internal only

zh-tw.content:
我一整天睡得最沉的那二十分鐘，發生在一張硬得要命的桌子上。
醒來時手臂壓出一條紅印、袖子有一小塊是濕的，整間教室安靜到只剩走廊偶爾一個腳步聲。晚上躺在真正的床上，我反而清醒到快兩點。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合午休剛結束、下午第一節之前發；床越軟越睡不著這件事，全班都能作證。
variations: 也能換成：「我的睡眠品質跟躺的地方成反比，這件事我每個中午都在重新驗證一次。」
進階版：「趴著二十分鐘可以直接斷線，躺著八小時可以完整重播我小學做過的每一件蠢事。」

en.content:
Twenty minutes face-down on a desk is the hardest I sleep all day.
Red line across my forearm, damp patch on my sleeve, one set of footsteps out in the hallway. Then I go home, lie on an actual mattress, and stay awake until almost two.
en.editorNote: For the stretch right after lunch break. Sleep quality and mattress quality have never been on speaking terms.
variations: Swap in: "My sleep quality runs inverse to how soft the surface is. I re-prove it every single lunch break."
Harder mode: "Twenty minutes on a desk: out cold. Eight hours on a bed: full replay of everything dumb I did in fifth grade."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 手搖店打工討論串 情境改寫

zh-tw.content:
我穿著工作服站在櫃檯，一抬頭，排到我面前的是同班同學。我們對看了半秒，然後他很自然地點餐、付錢、說謝謝，從頭到尾沒有多問一句。
那天下班我滑開手機，看到他傳來一張空杯子的照片，底下寫著：「很好喝，明天我還要來。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合有在排班的學生發；被同學撞見上班的那半秒很難形容，而對方當下怎麼處理，通常會被記很久。
variations: 也能換成：「他沒問我為什麼在這裡上班，只問我幾點下班——這題我答得比任何一堂課都快。」
進階版：「我怕了整個學期被同學看到我穿工作服，後來才發現，他們真的只是想買一杯。」

en.content:
Work shirt on, name tag crooked, and the next person in line is someone from my class. Half a second of eye contact. Then he orders, pays, says thanks, and asks nothing.
Clocked out, checked my phone: a photo of an empty cup. "That was good. Coming back tomorrow."
en.editorNote: For students picking up shifts. Getting spotted in uniform is a very specific half-second, and how the other person plays it gets remembered.
variations: Swap in: "He didn't ask why I work here. He asked what time I finish — fastest I've answered anything all semester."
Harder mode: "Spent a whole semester dreading classmates seeing the work shirt. Turns out they just wanted a drink."

items.sourceNote: Dcard 閒聊板班級幹部討論串 情境改寫

zh-tw.content:
選幹部那天，老師問有沒有人要自願當班長，沒有人舉手。
老師說：「那我用抽的。」
下一秒，全班突然都想起自己有補習、要顧弟妹，還有一個說他明年可能會轉學。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學第一週班會結束後發，全班一起裝忙的那個畫面，每間教室都上演過。
variations: 也能換成：「沒人想當班長，但抽籤箱一拿出來，全班的口才都變好了。」
進階版：「最後當選的是那個去上廁所的同學，他回來的時候，職位已經在等他了。」

en.content:
Officer elections. The teacher asks for a volunteer for class president. Not one hand.
Teacher says, "Fine, I'll draw names."
Suddenly everybody has tutoring, a little brother to pick up, and one guy announces he might transfer next year.
en.editorNote: For right after the first homeroom of the term. Every classroom has run this exact scene.
variations: Swap in: "Nobody wants the job, but the second a hat full of names comes out, the whole room finds its voice."
Harder mode: "The winner was the guy who stepped out to the bathroom. He came back to a job title."

items.sourceNote: 115 學年度開學日期報導 開學第一週情境發想

zh-tw.content:
開學第一週真正存進我腦袋的資訊：
一、四樓走廊有訊號，三樓沒有。
二、飲水機要按第二個鍵才出得來冰水。
三、我的座位剛好在冷氣正下方。
至於課本翻到第幾頁，我打算下禮拜再處理。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學第一週結束時發，課本內容一頁沒進去，生活情報倒是收得滿滿的。
variations: 也能換成：「我還不知道這學期要考什麼，但我已經知道哪一間廁所最乾淨。」
進階版：「開學一週，課本我還沒認識，整棟樓的插座我倒是都認識了。」

en.content:
What actually made it into my head during week one:
1. The fourth-floor hallway has signal. The third floor does not.
2. The water fountain only gives you cold on the second button.
3. My desk sits directly under the AC vent.
Which page the textbook is on is a next-week problem.
en.editorNote: For the end of the first week back. Zero pages of reading absorbed, full download of building logistics.
variations: Swap in: "No idea what's on the first test yet, but I know exactly which bathroom is the clean one."
Harder mode: "One week in. Haven't met the textbook, have personally located every outlet in the building."

items.sourceNote: 115 學年度行事曆報導 開學前準備情境發想

zh-tw.content:
註冊日領到一疊新課本，我媽拿出一整捲書套，說包起來才耐用。
包到最後，書套裡的空氣泡泡比我畫的重點還多。而包得最醜的那一本，剛好是這學期節數最多的一科。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合註冊日或開學前整理課本那天發，包書套的成果通常跟這學期的認真程度成反比。
variations: 也能換成：「書套包得越平整，代表我離翻開它還有越久。」
進階版：「每一本我都包好、貼好標籤，然後整學期只翻開其中兩本。」

en.content:
Registration day, a stack of brand-new textbooks, and my mom pulls out a roll of clear covering film. Says they hold up better this way.
By the end there are more trapped air bubbles under the plastic than notes inside the books. The ugliest one turned out to be the subject with the most class hours this term.
en.editorNote: For registration day or the night you sort your books. How neat the covers are runs inverse to how much of the term you survive.
variations: Swap in: "The smoother the cover job, the further away I am from actually opening it."
Harder mode: "Covered them all, labeled them all, opened exactly two."

items.sourceNote: Threads 開學前討論串 情境發想

zh-tw.content:
開學第一次朝會，校長講到「最後一件事」的時候，我把整個人的重量放回腳跟上。
那句「最後一件事」，後來又出現了兩次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學第一週站在司令台前發，太陽很大、話很長，這種絕望全國統一。
variations: 也能換成：「朝會唯一的懸疑感，就是校長說完『最後』之後，後面還藏著幾個『最後』。」
進階版：「我從國小站到現在，還是學不會判斷朝會什麼時候才會真的結束。」

en.content:
First assembly of the year. The principal says "one last thing" and I let my weight settle back onto my heels.
"One last thing" showed up twice more after that.
en.editorNote: For the first week, standing out on the field. Big sun, long speech, universally understood.
variations: Swap in: "The only suspense at assembly is how many more 'lastly's are hiding behind the first one."
Harder mode: "A decade of assemblies and I still can't call when one is actually over."

items.sourceNote: 開學用品清單報導 姓名貼紙情境發想

zh-tw.content: 開學前把姓名貼紙貼滿鉛筆盒，好像這樣就不會有東西離開我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前整理文具那天發，貼貼紙的心情其實有點慎重。
variations: 也能換成：「一包姓名貼紙一百張，我貼到連橡皮擦都有名字。」
進階版：「貼紙都貼好了，第一天還是弄丟一支筆。」

en.content: Covered the whole pencil case in name stickers, like that would keep anything from leaving me.
en.editorNote: For the night you sort your supplies. Sticking those on feels weirdly serious.
variations: Swap in: "A hundred name stickers in the pack, so even the eraser has a name now."
Harder mode: "Every sticker in place, and I still lost a pen on day one."

items.sourceNote: 開學收心相關報導 早自習情境發想

zh-tw.content: 開學第一天的早自習，我人七點十分到，靈魂七點五十才進教室。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學第一週早上發，身體先到、意識後到的那種恍神。
variations: 也能換成：「早自習的我只是一具幫我佔位子的軀殼。」
進階版：「暑假我天天四點睡，現在四點是我要起床的時間了。」

en.content: First morning study hall of the term: my body clocked in at 7:10, my soul got there around 7:50.
en.editorNote: For that first week of mornings, when only half of you makes it to class.
variations: Swap in: "At morning study hall I'm just a shell holding my own seat."
Harder mode: "All summer 4 a.m. was bedtime. Now it's almost wake-up time."

items.sourceNote: 115 學年度行事曆報導 開學前情境發想

zh-tw.content:
開學前一週我最先想起來的不是課表，是校車右邊倒數第二排靠窗的位子。
那台車一年載我三百多趟，我記得的卻只有窗外那兩分鐘的稻田。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前一週發，先想起座位、再想起功課的順序很誠實。
variations: 也能換成：「課表可以查，那個位子被別人坐走就沒了。」
進階版：「車上睡了三年，醒來的地點永遠準得像鬧鐘。」

en.content:
A week out from the new term, the first thing I remembered wasn't my schedule. It was the window seat, second row from the back, right side of the school bus.
That bus carried me three hundred trips a year and all I kept was two minutes of rice fields going past.
en.editorNote: For the week before school. Remembering the seat before the homework is honest.
variations: Swap in: "I can look up my schedule. I can't look up that seat once someone takes it."
Harder mode: "Three years of sleeping on that bus and I still woke up on cue every time."

items.sourceNote: 開學季文具用品整理文 情境發想

zh-tw.content: 開學第一週，全班共用一支訂書機。它換座位的次數比我這學期還多。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學第一週發，班上的公用文具永遠在流浪。
variations: 也能換成：「那支訂書機沒有主人，只有下一站。」
進階版：「它最後停在誰的抽屜，就是這學期的未解之謎。」

en.content: One stapler for the whole class the first week. It changed desks more times than I did all term.
en.editorNote: For week one, when the shared supplies never stay put.
variations: Swap in: "That stapler has no owner, only a next stop."
Harder mode: "Whose drawer it ends up in is this term's unsolved mystery."

items.sourceNote: 上課打瞌睡筆記變一條線的校園共感情境發想

zh-tw.content: 睡著那一刻我的筆還在動，醒來看筆記，最後三行是一條直線。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合下課後配一張筆記照發，坐後排的同學會秒認領。
variations: 也能換成：「我的筆比我還敬業，我都斷線了它還在寫。」
進階版：「那條線的長度，就是我睡著的時間。」

en.content: I fell asleep mid-sentence and my pen kept going. The last three lines of my notes are one long straight line.
en.editorNote: Post it with a photo of the notes after class — back-row kids will claim it instantly.
variations: Swap in: "My pen has a better work ethic than I do. I went offline and it kept writing."
Harder mode: "The length of that line is exactly how long I was out."

items.sourceNote: 老師突然叫名字反射喊有的課堂尷尬情境發想

zh-tw.content: 手撐著頭睡了十分鐘，老師突然叫我名字，我脫口而出「有」——那不是點名。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合被老師點起來回答問題卻答非所問的當天發，全班笑聲還在耳邊。
variations: 也能換成：「我答得很快，只是答錯了題型。」
進階版：「喊完那聲『有』，我才發現老師手上沒有點名表。」

en.content: Ten minutes of sleeping on my hand, then the teacher said my name and I blurted out "Here." It was not attendance.
en.editorNote: For the day you get called on and answer the wrong question entirely.
variations: Swap in: "Fast reply. Wrong format."
Harder mode: "Right after I said it, I noticed there was no roll sheet in his hand."

items.sourceNote: 上課偷睡手滑撞桌的經典糗態情境發想

zh-tw.content: 偷睡的最高風險不是被抓，是手一滑，整顆頭往下砸，全班都聽見。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在課堂糗事討論串裡丟出來，有過這一聲的人都會舉手。
variations: 也能換成：「支撐我上完這堂課的，只有那隻手肘。」
進階版：「那一聲之後，我只能假裝在撿東西。」

en.content: The real risk of sneaking a nap isn't getting caught. It's your hand slipping and your whole head hitting the desk out loud.
en.editorNote: Drop it in any thread about classroom disasters — everyone who's made that sound will raise a hand.
variations: Swap in: "The only thing holding me through that lecture was one elbow."
Harder mode: "After that noise, all I could do was pretend I dropped something."

items.sourceNote: 被抓包後裝認真翻課本翻錯頁的情境發想

zh-tw.content: 被抓包那一秒我沒慌，我翻了一下課本——翻到的那頁，跟老師講的差了兩章。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合裝認真失敗那天發，愛用課本當掩護的同學都懂。
variations: 也能換成：「我很鎮定地翻到了下學期。」
進階版：「老師沒說話，只是看了我的課本一眼。」

en.content: Caught mid-nap, I stayed calm and flipped my textbook open. The page I landed on was two chapters off from the lecture.
en.editorNote: For the day your cover story falls apart — textbook-as-camouflage users know this one.
variations: Swap in: "Very calmly, I turned to next semester."
Harder mode: "The teacher said nothing. He just looked at my textbook."

items.sourceNote: 請假單上不存在的那一格，原創發想

zh-tw.content:
如果請假單上多一格，叫做「沒有生病，就是不想來」，我猜勾下去的人會比想像中多很多。
那一格永遠不會出現，倒不是怕我們亂用——是怕大人自己也想勾。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合連上好幾天課、整個人麻掉那天發，貼在班群裡通常一票人跟著喊我也要。
variations: 也能換成：「請假理由那一欄，我最想寫的是『我需要一天』。」
進階版：「大人不是不懂，他們是比我們早幾年學會不寫出來。」

en.content:
If the absence form had one more box — "Not sick, just don't want to come" — I bet way more people would check it than anyone expects.
That box will never exist. Not because they think we'd abuse it, but because the adults would want to check it too.
en.editorNote: For the day you're running on fumes after a long stretch of classes. Post it in the group chat and watch the me-toos roll in.
variations: Swap in: "In the reason field, what I really want to write is: I need one day."
Harder mode: "Adults get it. They just learned a few years earlier not to write it down."

items.sourceNote: 修正帶蓋不掉厚度的觸感觀察，原創發想

zh-tw.content:
修正帶蓋得掉字，蓋不掉厚度。
寫錯的那一行，之後每次翻到，指腹都會先摸到那一小段凸起來——本子記得的，比我願意承認的還多。
zh-tw.editorNote: 訂正完考卷、或想講「錯誤不會憑空消失」的時候發，配一張筆記本特寫剛剛好。
variations: 也能換成：「白色蓋上去那一秒最安心，隔天翻回來才知道它還在。」
溫柔版：「凸起來也沒關係，那是我改過的地方。」

en.content:
Correction tape can cover the word. It can't cover the thickness.
On the line where I messed up, my fingertip finds that little ridge every time I flip back — the notebook remembers more than I'm willing to admit.
en.editorNote: Good after a round of corrections, or when you want to say mistakes don't just vanish. Pair it with a close-up of your notebook.
variations: Swap in: "The second the white goes on it feels fixed. You find out the next day it's still there."
Softer take: "The ridge is fine. It just means I went back and fixed it."

items.sourceNote: 教室時鐘慢幾分鐘、全班照樣用的班級默契發想

zh-tw.content:
教室後面那個時鐘慢四分鐘，全班都清楚，但誰也懶得去調。
老師照著它宣布下課，我們照著它算還剩多久，久了大家就默默同意：這間教室的時間，本來就跟外面差四分鐘。
而那四分鐘，只在這扇門裡面有效。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊班上那種沒人明講、卻全員遵守的默契，畢業前發特別有感。
variations: 也能換成：「我們不是遲到四分鐘，我們是活在四分鐘之前。」
簡短版：「全班靠一個壞掉的時鐘準時。」

en.content:
The clock at the back of the room runs four minutes slow. Everyone knows. Nobody bothers to fix it.
The teacher lets us out by it, we count down by it, and somewhere along the way we all quietly agreed that time in this room is simply four minutes behind.
Those four minutes are only valid inside that door.
en.editorNote: For talking about the unspoken rules every class runs on. Hits harder if you post it near graduation.
variations: Swap in: "We're not four minutes late. We live four minutes ago."
Short version: "A whole class kept on time by one broken clock."

items.sourceNote: 翹大課以為藏得住、結果因為全勤缺席被記住的翻轉發想

zh-tw.content:
都說要翹就翹大課，三百個人的階梯教室，少一個哪看得出來。
我信了一整個學期。
期末最後一堂，教授在台上唸了一個名字，要那個人下課留一下——三百個人裡，他偏偏記得我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 翹課翻車那天拿來自嘲，也很適合回給那些說大課點名不重要的人。
variations: 也能換成：「我以為我藏在人群裡，其實我就是那個唯一的空位。」
進階版：「他記得的不是我，是那個位子整學期沒坐過人。」

en.content:
Everyone says if you're going to skip, skip the big lecture — three hundred people, who notices one missing?
I believed that for an entire semester.
On the last day, the professor read out one name from the podium and asked that person to stay after class. Out of three hundred, he remembered me.
en.editorNote: Self-roast material for the day your skipping streak catches up with you. Also a solid reply to anyone who says big lectures don't track attendance.
variations: Swap in: "I thought I was hiding in the crowd. I was the one empty seat."
Harder mode: "He didn't remember me. He remembered the seat nobody sat in all semester."

items.sourceNote: 就學貸款對保當天在銀行櫃檯簽名的心情，校園共感情境發想

zh-tw.content:
你會在某個平常的下午被叫去銀行，帶著印章和一疊資料。承辦人員把單子推過來，指著最後一行說請在這裡簽名。
你簽的時候手很穩，因為你還看不懂那個數字有多重。走出大門陽光很大，你唯一的感覺是有點餓。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合辦完學貸手續那天發，也可以轉給正在為學費算數字的朋友。
variations: 也能換成：「那天我簽了人生第一份跟錢有關的文件，字比考卷上寫得還工整。」
溫柔版：「單子上的數字要幾年後才會有重量，那天它只是一行字。」

en.content:
Some ordinary weekday afternoon, you'll get sent to a bank with your seal and a stack of paperwork. The clerk slides the form across the counter and points at the last line: sign here.
Your hand is perfectly steady, because you still can't feel how heavy that number is. You walk back out into bright sunlight and the only thing you notice is that you're hungry.
en.editorNote: For the day the student loan paperwork is finally done. Also works sent to a friend doing tuition math.
variations: Swap in: "First document I ever signed about money, and my handwriting was neater than on any exam."
Softer version: "That number won't have any weight for a few more years. That day it was just a line of text."

items.sourceNote: 學校各行政單位互踢皮球、一張表單跑不完的校園情境發想

zh-tw.content:
我拿著一張要蓋三個章的表單去教務處，櫃檯說這個要先給系上簽。系上翻了兩秒說，那要先有教務處的章才算數。
我在兩層樓之間來回走了四趟，紙上還是乾乾淨淨。這學期我流最多汗的一堂課，是這張紙。
zh-tw.editorNote: 被學校行政流程卡住那天發最有感，跑公文跑到懷疑人生的人都會轉。
variations: 也能換成：「這張表教我的事，比它要辦的那門課還多。」
簡短版：「三個章、四趟樓梯、零進度。」

en.content:
I took a form that needed three stamps to the registrar, and the front desk said my department has to sign it first. My department looked at it for two seconds and said it doesn't count without the registrar's stamp.
I walked between two floors four times and the paper was still completely blank. The sweatiest class I took this semester was one sheet of paper.
en.editorNote: Post it the day campus admin sends you in a circle. Anyone who's chased signatures will forward it.
variations: Swap in: "That form taught me more than the course it was for."
Short version: "Three stamps, four flights of stairs, zero progress."

items.sourceNote: 校園走廊販賣機每天被按同一個鍵的日常慣性，擬人化發想

zh-tw.content:
走廊那台販賣機如果開口，第一句應該是「我認得你」。
「你連續三十四天按同一個按鍵，第三十五天手指移到旁邊那格，停了兩秒。」「那兩秒我也在等，想看看你會不會真的換一種活法。」「後來你按了退幣，又按回原本那個。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 配一張販賣機照片發限動剛好，也適合吐槽自己一成不變的日常。
variations: 也能換成：「我以為我在選飲料，其實我每天只是在確認自己沒變。」
簡短版：「連販賣機都比我早知道我不會改。」

en.content:
If the vending machine in the hallway could talk, the first thing it'd say is "I know you."
"Thirty-four days in a row, same button. On day thirty-five your finger slid one slot over and hovered there for two full seconds." "I was waiting through those two seconds too, wondering if you'd actually change your life." "Then you hit coin return and went straight back to the usual."
en.editorNote: Pairs well with a photo of a vending machine. Good for roasting your own unchanging routine.
variations: Swap in: "I thought I was picking a drink. I was checking that I hadn't changed."
Short version: "Even the vending machine knew I wasn't going to switch."

items.sourceNote: 暑假看校外租屋覺得很安靜、九月大家搬回來才知道真相的翻轉發想

zh-tw.content:
八月看房那天，房東站在陽台上跟我說這一帶「非常安靜」。我當場就簽了，還在心裡稱讚自己眼光好。
九月的第一個週末，整棟樓的人一起搬了回來。我這才想通，八月的安靜是因為大家都還沒回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛搬進校外租屋處、發現房東的形容詞有時效性的時候發。
variations: 也能換成：「房東沒騙我，他只是沒說那是限時的。」
進階版：「原來安靜這件事，也是有季節的。」

en.content:
The day I viewed the place in August, the landlord stood on the balcony and told me the neighborhood was "very quiet." I signed on the spot and congratulated myself on having good instincts.
The first weekend of September, the entire building moved back in at once. That's when it clicked that August was quiet because nobody had returned yet.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just moved into off-campus housing and learned that a landlord's adjectives have an expiration date.
variations: Swap in: "He didn't lie to me. He just didn't mention it was a limited-time offer."
Harder mode: "Turns out quiet is seasonal."

items.sourceNote: 教授說會考／不會考時全班筆同時起落的課堂旁觀發想

zh-tw.content:
教授在台上說「這一段會考」的時候，全班的筆同時動了起來。三分鐘後他補一句「這頁跳過，不會考」，二十幾支筆在同一秒停住。
那是這堂課從頭到尾最整齊的一次。我們的專注力一直都在，它只是很挑要落在哪一句。
zh-tw.editorNote: 考前一週發最準，也可以拿來回敬那些說學生上課都不專心的人。
variations: 也能換成：「全班反應最快的一次，是聽到『這個不會考』。」
簡短版：「筆會不會動，取決於那句話後面有沒有『會考』。」

en.content:
The second the professor said "this part is on the exam," every pen in the room started moving at once. Three minutes later he added "skip this page, it won't be tested," and twenty-some pens stopped in the same second.
That was the most synchronized this class ever got. Our focus was there the whole time — it's just extremely picky about which sentence it lands on.
en.editorNote: Best posted the week before finals. Also a decent comeback for anyone who says students never pay attention.
variations: Swap in: "Fastest this class ever reacted was to the words 'not on the exam.'"
Short version: "Whether the pen moves depends on what comes after the sentence."
